chapters.title: Welcome Unit 初高中衔接
chapters.summary: 衔接初高中英语，复习基本句型结构、学习策略与校园生活词汇。

knowledge.title: 五大基本句型
knowledge.content: 英语句子千变万化，但归根结底都由五大基本句型扩展而来。掌握句型分析是阅读长难句和写作的基础。①S+V（主谓）：主语+不及物动词。例：The sun rises. 太阳升起。The baby cried. 婴儿哭了。②S+V+O（主谓宾）：主语+及物动词+宾语。例：I love English. 我爱英语。She reads books every day. 她每天读书。③S+V+IO+DO（主谓双宾）：主语+动词+间接宾语（人）+直接宾语（物）。例：He gave me a book. 他给了我一本书。Mother bought me a gift. 妈妈给我买了礼物。④S+V+O+C（主谓宾补）：主语+动词+宾语+宾补（补充说明宾语的状态或身份）。例：We elected him monitor. 我们选他当班长。The news made him happy. 这个消息让他高兴。⑤S+V+P（主系表）：主语+系动词+表语。例：She is a teacher. 她是老师。The soup tastes delicious. 汤尝起来很美味。学习提示：分析句子时，第一步先找谓语动词，第二步判断动词类型（及物/不及物/系动词），第三步确定句型结构。系动词除了be动词外，还有感官动词（look, sound, smell, taste, feel）、变化类（become, get, grow, turn）、保持类（keep, stay, remain）等。

knowledge.title: 校园生活词汇
knowledge.content: campus 校园（指学校整体场地，区别于school泛指学校）；lecture 讲座/讲课（大学常用，区别于lesson中小学课程）；registration 注册/登记；dormitory 宿舍（口语常缩写为dorm）；exchange 交流（exchange student 交换生）；strategy 策略/方法（learning strategy 学习策略）；flashcard 抽认卡（背单词工具）；take notes 记笔记；concentrate on 专注/集中注意力于。词汇搭配：register for a course 选课注册；exchange ideas 交流想法；apply strategies 运用策略；make flashcards 制作抽认卡。易错提示：campus和school不要混用，campus强调物理空间；lecture比lesson更正式，多用于大学语境。

knowledge.title: 学习策略
knowledge.content: 高中英语学习相比初中，词汇量要求大幅提升（高考3500+词），阅读篇幅更长，语法更系统。推荐策略：①扩大词汇量：利用构词法（前缀un-, dis-, re-等；后缀-tion, -ment, -ful等）批量记忆；在语境中记单词而非孤立背诵。②坚持听说读写训练：每天至少15分钟听力，坚持朗读课文培养语感。③建立错题本：分类整理语法、词汇、完形、阅读错题，定期复习。④用英语记日记：哪怕每天写三五句，培养英语思维和写作习惯。⑤利用词典与语料：遇到生词查英英词典培养英语思维，利用词典例句学习搭配。学习提示：高中英语重在积累和运用，切忌死记硬背，要注重在真实语境中理解和运用语言。

exam_points.title: 句型分析
exam_points.content: 高考阅读和完形中常出现长难句，句型分析是理解的关键。解题技巧：①先找主句谓语动词（注意排除从句中的动词干扰）；②再判断主句基本结构；③最后分析从句和修饰成分。注意区分宾语和宾补：宾补是补充说明宾语，去掉后句子意思不完整；双宾语中两个宾语之间是平等关系，没有补充说明的关系。例：I found the book interesting.（interesting是宾补，补充说明book的状态）；I gave him a pen.（him和a pen是双宾，him是间接宾语，a pen是直接宾语）。

exam_points.title: 词义推断
exam_points.content: 阅读理解中遇到生词是常态，掌握推断技巧至关重要。解题技巧：①构词法推断：利用前缀、后缀、合成词推断词义。如unforgettable = un(不)+forget(忘记)+able(能够) = 难忘的。②上下文推断：通过同义关系（or, namely, that is）、反义关系（but, however, unlike）、举例（such as, for example）推断。③定义线索：定语从句、同位语、破折号解释等直接给出定义。④因果推断：通过因果关系推断词义。学习提示：考试中不要一见生词就慌，大多数生词都能通过上下文推断，平时阅读时刻意练习猜词能力。

examples.title: 句型判断（基础题）
examples.question: 指出 "She bought me a dictionary." 的句型结构。
examples.analysis: 第一步：找谓语动词bought（buy的过去式），是及物动词。第二步：分析动词后的成分——me是接受动作的人（间接宾语），a dictionary是接受动作的物（直接宾语）。第三步：两个宾语之间是平等关系，不是补充说明关系，因此是双宾结构而非宾补结构。
examples.answer: S+V+IO+DO（主谓双宾结构）。me是间接宾语（IO），a dictionary是直接宾语（DO）。

examples.title: 宾语与宾补辨析（中档题）
examples.question: 判断下列句子的句型："We call him Xiao Ming."
examples.analysis: 第一步：谓语动词call。第二步：him是宾语。第三步：判断Xiao Ming是宾语还是宾补——如果把Xiao Ming去掉，"We call him"意思不完整（我们叫他什么？），说明Xiao Ming是补充说明him的身份/名称，是宾补而非宾语。对比："We gave him a book"中，him和a book都是宾语，去掉a book后"We gave him"虽然不完整但give可以接双宾。关键区别：宾补与宾语之间有逻辑上的主谓或主表关系（him = Xiao Ming），双宾语之间没有这种关系。
examples.answer: S+V+O+C（主谓宾补结构）。him是宾语（O），Xiao Ming是宾语补足语（C）。

examples.title: 词义推断（中档题）
examples.question: 阅读理解：The new policy was controversial; in other words, many people disputed it. 根据上下文推断controversial的含义。
examples.analysis: 分析上下文线索：分号后的in other words（换句话说）是同义解释信号词，说明后半句是对前半句的解释。后半句"many people disputed it"意为"很多人争议/质疑它"。因此controversial应与"有争议的"意思相近。这道题考查利用同义解释信号词（in other words）推断生词的能力。
examples.answer: controversial意为"有争议的、引起争论的"。通过in other words后的同义解释disputed（争议）推断得出。

examples.title: 系动词辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 用括号内动词的适当形式填空：The food on the table ______ (smell) delicious, and everyone wants to try it.
examples.analysis: 本题考查系动词的用法。smell作感官动词时是连系动词，后接形容词作表语，表示食物闻起来的状态。 delicious是形容词，因此smell用一般现在时smells（主语food是不可数名词，用第三人称单数）。易错点：学生容易把smell误用为实义动词而加副词（smells deliciously），但此处smell是系动词，后接形容词。解题技巧：感官动词（look, sound, smell, taste, feel）后接形容词时是系动词，后接副词时是实义动词。如：The flowers smell sweet.（系动词+形容词）；The dog smelled carefully.（实义动词+副词）。
examples.answer: smells。smell在此为系动词，主语food为不可数名词，用第三人称单数形式。

past_exams.question: The soup ______ (taste) delicious, and everyone wants to try it.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查系动词的用法。taste作感官动词时是连系动词，后接形容词作表语。delicious是形容词，因此taste用一般现在时tastes（主语soup是不可数名词，用第三人称单数）。解题关键：感官动词后接形容词时是系动词。
past_exams.answer: tastes。taste为系动词，主语soup为不可数名词，用第三人称单数。

past_exams.question:
指出句型结构：We elected him monitor of our class.
A. S+V+O  B. S+V+IO+DO  C. S+V+O+C  D. S+V+P
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查五大基本句型的辨析。谓语动词elected是及物动词，him是宾语，monitor是补充说明him的身份（宾补）。如果去掉monitor，句子意思不完整（我们选他当什么？），说明monitor是宾补。宾补与宾语之间有逻辑上的主表关系（him = monitor）。
past_exams.answer: C. S+V+O+C。him是宾语，monitor是宾语补足语。

past_exams.question: She bought ______ (I) a new dictionary as a birthday gift.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查双宾结构。bought是及物动词，后接双宾语：me（间接宾语，人）和a new dictionary（直接宾语，物）。两个宾语之间是平等关系，不是补充说明关系。需要填入人称代词的宾格形式me。
past_exams.answer: me。bought后接双宾语，间接宾语用宾格。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：On the first day of high school, I walked into the classroom nervously. The teacher asked us to introduce ourselves. When it was my turn, I stood up and said, 'My name is Li Hua.' The teacher smiled and said, 'Welcome to our ______.'
A. campus  B. factory  C. hospital  D. farm
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查校园生活词汇。语境是高中开学第一天，老师欢迎学生来到"校园"。campus指校园（学校整体场地），符合语境。factory（工厂）、hospital（医院）、farm（农场）均与学校语境无关。
past_exams.answer: A. campus。campus意为"校园"，符合开学第一天的语境。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：A good learning strategy is to use flashcards to memorize new words. Studies show that students who use flashcards regularly tend to remember 40% more vocabulary than those who don't. The key is to review them frequently rather than cramming all at once.
According to the passage, why are flashcards effective?
A. They help students write faster.
B. They improve vocabulary retention.
C. They make classes more interesting.
D. They reduce homework time.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查细节理解。文章明确指出"students who use flashcards regularly tend to remember 40% more vocabulary"，说明抽认卡能有效提高词汇记忆保留率。选项B与文章一致。
past_exams.answer: B。文章指出使用抽认卡的学生比不使用的多记住40%的词汇。

past_exams.question: In other words, the word is ______ (forget), which means you cannot remember it.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查词义推断和构词法。"In other words"（换句话说）是同义解释信号词，后半句"which means you cannot remember it"意为"意味着你无法记住它"。根据构词法：unforgettable = un(不) + forget(忘记) + able(能够) = 难忘的。
past_exams.answer: unforgettable。根据in other words后的同义解释和构词法推断。

past_exams.question: The news made him very ______ (happiness), and he smiled all day long.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查宾补结构和词形变化。谓语动词made后接宾语him和宾补，him（人）感到高兴，用形容词happy。happiness是名词，需要变为形容词happy。
past_exams.answer: happy。make后接形容词作宾补，happiness变形容词happy。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to develop good study habits in high school?
___1___ First, set a regular study schedule and stick to it. Consistency is the key to success.
___2___ Second, take notes actively in class. Don't just copy what the teacher writes on the board.
___3___ Third, review your notes within 24 hours after class.
A. Consistency helps you build a routine.
B. Active note-taking improves understanding.
C. Timely review prevents forgetting.
D. Exercise is also important.
E. Sleep well every night.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查段落主旨与标题匹配。第一段关键词是consistency（一致性），对应A。第二段关键词是active note-taking，对应B。第三段关键词是timely review（及时复习），对应C。D和E与各段主旨不符。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段主旨分别对应一致性、积极记笔记和及时复习。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Many high school students struggle with the transition from middle school to high school. The workload increases dramatically. However, students who learn to analyze sentence structures early on tend to perform better in reading comprehension. Understanding the five basic sentence patterns is the foundation of decoding complex sentences.
What is the main idea of the passage?
A. High school is too difficult for most students.
B. Sentence structure analysis helps with reading.
C. Students should read more books in high school.
D. The workload in high school is manageable.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查主旨大意。文章通过However转折引出核心观点：学会分析句子结构的学生在阅读理解中表现更好，掌握五大基本句型是理解长难句的基础。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。文章主旨是句子结构分析有助于阅读理解。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你的初中同学张伟刚升入高中，觉得学习压力很大，写信向你求助。请你给他写一封回信，分享你的学习策略和建议。
范文：Dear Zhang Wei,
I'm sorry to hear that you're feeling stressed about high school studies. I completely understand how you feel. Here are some strategies that might help.
First, it's important to build a good habit of taking notes in class. Try to write down the key points rather than copying everything. Second, I strongly recommend making flashcards to memorize new vocabulary. Reviewing them regularly is much more effective than cramming. Third, don't hesitate to ask your teachers for help when you have questions.
Remember, high school is a marathon, not a sprint. Stay positive and keep working hard.
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查建议信写作。写作要点：①格式正确（称呼、正文、结尾、签名）；②结构清晰（表示理解→分享建议→鼓励）；③建议具体可行；④语言得体，语气友好鼓励。范文中使用了It's important to..., I strongly recommend...等建议句式。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：格式正确、内容完整、语言流畅、建议具体。

chapters.title: Unit 1 Teenage Life 青少年生活
chapters.summary: 话题：青少年生活与课外活动。语法：复习时态。写作：建议信。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: volunteer 志愿者/自愿做（volunteer to do sth. 自愿做某事）；debate 辩论/争论（have a debate 举行辩论）；prefer 更喜欢（prefer A to B 喜欢A胜过B）；suitable 合适的（be suitable for 适合）；challenge 挑战（accept/take up a challenge 接受挑战）；schedule 日程/安排（a tight schedule 紧凑的日程）；quit 放弃/退出（quit doing sth. 放弃做某事）；responsible 负责任的（be responsible for 对……负责）；generation 一代人（generation gap 代沟）；attract 吸引（attract one's attention 吸引注意力）；focus 集中（focus on 集中于）；advance 进步/前进（in advance 提前）。词汇辨析：prefer指在两者中更偏爱其一；choose指一般性选择；select指精选。challenge指需要努力应对的挑战；difficulty指一般困难。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: prefer...to... 喜欢……胜过……（注意to是介词，后接名词或动名词）；sign up for 报名参加（后接活动名称）；be suitable for 适合（后接人或物）；focus on 集中于；be responsible for 对……负责；hand out 分发（hand in 上交；hand down 传下来）；be addicted to 沉迷于（to是介词，后接动名词）；get used to 习惯于（to是介词，后接名词或动名词）。易错提示：be addicted to和get used to中的to都是介词，后面必须接名词或动名词，不能接动词原形。这是高频考点。例：He is addicted to playing games.（不能说to play games）

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①I prefer... to... 我喜欢……胜过……。例：I prefer reading to watching TV. 我喜欢读书胜过看电视。②The reason why... is that... ……的原因是……。例：The reason why he was late is that he missed the bus. 他迟到的原因是错过了公交。注意：why引导定语从句，that引导表语从句，不能用because替换that。③It is + adj. + for sb. to do sth. 对某人来说做某事是……的。例：It is important for us to learn English well. 学好英语对我们很重要。④You'd better (not) do... 你最好（不）做……。例：You'd better not stay up late. 你最好别熬夜。注意：had better后接动词原形，否定直接加not。

knowledge.title: 语法：复习时态
knowledge.content: 高中阶段需系统掌握的时态：①一般现在时：表习惯、真理、客观事实。时间状语：always, usually, often, every day。例：The earth goes around the sun. 地球绕着太阳转。②一般过去时：表过去某个时间发生的动作或状态。时间状语：yesterday, last week, in 2010, ago。例：I visited my grandparents last Sunday. ③现在进行时：表现在正在进行的动作或现阶段一直在做的事。时间状语：now, at the moment, look, listen。例：I am studying English now. ④现在完成时：表过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或过去开始持续到现在的动作。时间状语：already, yet, ever, never, just, so far, up to now, since, for。例：I have finished my homework. / I have lived here for ten years. ⑤一般将来时：表将来要发生的动作。时间状语：tomorrow, next week, in the future。例：I will visit you tomorrow. 时态呼应原则：主句为过去时，从句也用过去时态（客观真理除外）。例：He said he would come. 他说他会来。学习提示：做题时先看时间状语，再判断时态；没有时间状语时根据语境判断。

exam_points.title: 词汇与短语
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①prefer的词形变化：prefer→preferred/preferred→preferring（双写r）；preference（名词，偏好）。②be addicted to 后接动名词，高考常在语法填空中考查。③focus与concentrate辨析：两者都可接on，但focus还可作名词（焦点），concentrate更强调集中精力。④quit后接doing不接to do。解题技巧：遇到to要判断是介词还是不定式符号——look forward to, be/get used to, be addicted to, devote...to, object to中的to都是介词，后接动名词。

exam_points.title: 时态
exam_points.content: 时态是语法填空和完形填空的高频考点。解题技巧：①找时间标志词：last/ago/yesterday→过去时；so far/since/for/already/yet→现在完成时；now/look/listen→进行时。②无时间标志时根据语境判断：叙述过去的事用过去时；描述普遍现象用现在时。③注意主从句时态呼应：主句过去时，从句也用过去范畴的时态。④since从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时。例：I have known him since I was a child. 易错点：for+时间段既可用于过去时也可用于完成时，需看语境。如：I lived there for 3 years.（过去住过，现在不住了）；I have lived there for 3 years.（现在还住着）。

exam_points.title: 建议信写作
exam_points.content: 建议信是高考应用文写作高频题型。写作要点：①格式：称呼（Dear...,）、正文、结尾（Yours, / Best wishes, 签名）。②结构：先说明写信目的，再给出具体建议（分条列出），最后表达期望。③常用句式：I suggest/recommend that you (should) do...；It is advisable to do...；Why not do...? / Why don't you do...?；You'd better do...；If I were you, I would do...。④连接词：First, Besides, What's more, Finally, In short。学习提示：建议要具体可行，语气委婉礼貌，避免命令式。

examples.title: 时态选择（基础题）
examples.question: 用适当形式填空：He ______ (join) the chess club last term and ______ (be) a member ever since.
examples.analysis: 分析两个空格的时态：第一个空有last term（上学期）这个过去时间状语，表示过去发生的动作，用一般过去时joined。第二个空有ever since（从那以后一直）这个标志性时间状语，表示从过去某时持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时has been。这道题考查时态的核心区别：一般过去时只表过去，现在完成时强调对现在的影响或持续。
examples.answer: joined; has been。last term用一般过去时；ever since提示现在完成时。

examples.title: 介词to后的动名词（中档题）
examples.question: 语法填空：He is addicted to ______ (play) video games and his parents are worried about him.
examples.analysis: 本题考查be addicted to结构中to的词性。be addicted to意为"沉迷于"，此处的to是介词而非不定式符号，后面必须接名词或动名词。因此空格处应填playing。解题技巧：判断to是介词还是不定式符号，关键看前面的搭配。常见to作介词的短语有：be addicted to, be/get used to, look forward to, devote...to, object to, pay attention to, stick to等。这些短语后接动词时都要用动名词形式。
examples.answer: playing。be addicted to中to为介词，后接动名词。

examples.title: 建议句式翻译（中档题）
examples.question: 翻译：我建议你报名参加辩论社。
examples.analysis: 本题考查suggest引导建议的句式。suggest后接that从句时，从句谓语用should + 动词原形（虚拟语气），should可以省略。"报名参加"用sign up for，"辩论社"用debate club。句式结构：I suggest that you (should) sign up for the debate club. 注意：suggest后接动名词也可以：I suggest signing up for the debate club. 但不能说I suggest you to sign up（suggest后不接sb. to do）。
examples.answer: I suggest that you (should) sign up for the debate club.

examples.title: 时态综合（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：So far, millions of students ______ (benefit) from the new educational policy.
examples.analysis: 本题考查现在完成时的用法。时间状语so far（到目前为止）是现在完成时的标志性词汇，表示从过去到现在这段时间内完成的动作或产生的影响。主语millions of students是复数，因此助动词用have。benefit的过去分词是benefited（注意不需要双写t）。解题技巧：so far, up to now, until now都是现在完成时标志词，看到就要条件反射地想到现在完成时。
examples.answer: have benefited。so far提示用现在完成时，主语为复数用have。

examples.title: prefer用法（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 句型转换：I like reading books better than watching TV. → I ______ reading books ______ watching TV.
examples.analysis: 本题考查prefer...to...句型。原句"I like reading books better than watching TV"意为"我喜欢读书胜过看电视"，可转换为"I prefer reading books to watching TV"。prefer A to B表示"喜欢A胜过B"，其中to是介词，前后两端接相同结构（此处都是动名词）。注意：也可以用would rather...than...结构，但would rather后接动词原形：I would rather read books than watch TV.
examples.answer: prefer; to。prefer A to B表示"喜欢A胜过B"。

past_exams.question: He ______ (join) the chess club last term and ______ (be) a member ever since.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查时态。第一个空有last term，用一般过去时joined。第二个空有ever since，表示从过去持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时has been。
past_exams.answer: joined; has been。last term用一般过去时；ever since提示现在完成时。

past_exams.question: I prefer ______ (read) books to ______ (watch) TV in my free time.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查prefer...to...结构。prefer A to B中to是介词，前后接相同结构（此处都用动名词）。
past_exams.answer: reading; watching。prefer...to...中to是介词，后接动名词。

past_exams.question: So far, millions of students ______ (benefit) from the new educational policy.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查现在完成时。时间状语so far是现在完成时的标志词。主语复数用have。
past_exams.answer: have benefited。so far提示现在完成时，主语复数用have。

past_exams.question: He is addicted to ______ (play) video games and his parents are worried about him.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查be addicted to结构。be addicted to中to是介词而非不定式符号，后接名词或动名词。
past_exams.answer: playing。be addicted to中to为介词，后接动名词。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：Li Hua was a shy boy who preferred staying in the library to ______ sports with his classmates. One day, his teacher encouraged him to sign up for the debate club. At first, Li Hua was nervous, but he decided to ______ the challenge.
A. playing; take up  B. play; give up  C. playing; give up  D. play; take up
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查prefer...to...结构和take up a challenge。第一空：prefer doing A to doing B，to是介词，用动名词playing。第二空："接受挑战"用take up a challenge。
past_exams.answer: A. playing; take up。prefer...to...中to为介词接动名词；take up a challenge接受挑战。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：A growing number of teenagers are signing up for volunteer programs during summer vacation. According to a survey, over 60% of high school students participated in at least one volunteer activity last year. 'Volunteering not only helps others but also teaches us responsibility,' said one student. Experts point out that volunteer work can also improve social skills and broaden horizons.
What benefit of volunteering is NOT mentioned?
A. Helping others.  B. Learning responsibility.  C. Improving grades.  D. Broadening horizons.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查细节理解中的排除法。文章提到了帮助他人、学习责任感、提高社交技能、开阔视野。选项C（提高成绩）文章未提及。
past_exams.answer: C。文章未提到志愿服务能提高成绩。

past_exams.question: The reason ______ he was late is ______ he missed the school bus this morning.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查The reason why... is that...句型。第一空why引导定语从句修饰reason。第二空that引导表语从句，不能用because替换that。
past_exams.answer: why; that。why引导定语从句；that引导表语从句，不能用because。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to manage your time effectively in high school?
___1___ Make a weekly schedule and write down all your tasks.
___2___ Learn to say no to activities that take up too much of your time. Focus on what matters most.
___3___ Break large tasks into smaller ones.
A. Plan ahead.  B. Prioritize your tasks.  C. Break tasks down.  D. Get enough sleep.  E. Eat healthy food.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"制定周计划"，对应A（提前计划）。第二段讲"专注于最重要的"，对应B（确定优先级）。第三段讲"将大任务分解为小任务"，对应C（分解任务）。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调计划、优先排序和分解任务。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Research shows that teenagers who participate in extracurricular activities tend to have better time management skills. However, the key is balance. Students who are involved in too many activities often experience burnout. Dr. Smith suggests that students should choose no more than two or three activities that truly interest them.
According to Dr. Smith, what is the key to participating in extracurricular activities?
A. Joining as many as possible.  B. Choosing activities that interest you, but not too many.  C. Focusing only on academic clubs.  D. Avoiding all extracurricular activities.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出关键在于平衡，参与太多活动会导致倦怠。Dr. Smith建议选择不超过两三个真正感兴趣的活动。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。Dr. Smith建议选择不超过两三个真正感兴趣的活动。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你的英国笔友Tom来信说他刚进入高中，不适应新的学习生活，感到焦虑。请你给他写一封建议信。
范文：Dear Tom,
I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble adapting to high school life. I completely understand how you feel.
Here are some suggestions. First, I suggest that you should sign up for a club that interests you. It's a great way to make new friends. Second, you'd better make a study schedule and stick to it. What's more, don't be afraid to ask your teachers for help.
I believe you will adapt to the new environment soon. Keep a positive attitude and everything will get better.
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查建议信写作。①格式正确；②结构清晰（理解安慰→具体建议→祝福鼓励）；③建议句式多样（I suggest that..., you'd better...）；④连接词使用得当。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：格式、内容、语言、建议可行性。

chapters.title: Unit 2 Travelling Around 旅游
chapters.summary: 话题：旅游与目的地。语法：现在进行时表将来。写作：旅行计划/游记。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: destination 目的地（reach one's destination 到达目的地）；amazing 令人惊叹的（amaze v. 使惊叹）；ancient 古老的（ancient civilization 古代文明）；narrow 狭窄的（narrow street 狭窄街道）；flight 航班（take a flight 乘航班；fly v. 飞）；accommodation 住宿（不可数名词，book accommodation 预订住宿）；unique 独特的（be unique to ...独有的）；official 官方的（official language 官方语言）；emperor 皇帝；site 遗址/地点（historical site 历史遗址）；economy 经济（economic adj. 经济的）。词汇辨析：amaze强调令人惊奇、惊叹；surprise强调意外；astonish强调难以置信。ancient指远古的、历史悠久的；old泛指旧的、年老的。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: apply for 申请（后接名词，apply for a visa 申请签证）；take control of 控制/掌握；other than 除了（=except，后接名词或动词原形）；make up 构成/编造/弥补（make up for 弥补）；check in 办理登记入住（check out 结账离开）；be famous for 因……著名（be famous as 作为……著名）；package tour 跟团游。易错提示：other than和except用法相似，但other than更正式；check in和check out是反义短语，注意区分。make up含义多样，需根据语境判断：make up a story 编故事；make up 30% of... 占30%；make up for lost time 弥补失去的时间。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①be doing sth. 表按计划即将发生的动作（位移动词的进行时表将来）。例：I am leaving for Beijing tomorrow. 我明天动身去北京。②It is amazing that... ……令人惊叹。例：It is amazing that the ancient pyramid still stands. 令人惊叹的是古老的金字塔依然矗立。③主语 + be + to do 表按计划安排将要做的事。例：The President is to visit China next month. 总统将于下月访华。学习提示：be to do比will do更正式，强调按计划安排；be going to do强调打算或根据迹象推断即将发生的事。

knowledge.title: 语法：现在进行时表将来
knowledge.content: 现在进行时表将来是重要语法点。核心规则：come, go, arrive, leave, start, begin, fly, travel, drive, stay等位移动词（及部分非位移动词如do, have, meet, see off等）的现在进行时可表示按计划、安排即将发生的动作。例：I am flying to Shanghai tomorrow. 我明天飞往上海。The train is arriving soon. 火车快到了。We are having a meeting this afternoon. 我们今天下午开会。与be going to的区别：be going to侧重主观打算或根据目前迹象推断；现在进行时表将来侧重已经安排好的计划。与be to do的区别：be to do更正式，强调官方安排。易错点：并非所有动词的进行时都能表将来，只有表短暂性动作的动词（尤其是位移动词）才可以。状态动词（know, love, understand等）的进行时不表将来。

exam_points.title: 现在进行时表将来
exam_points.content: 高考常在语法填空和单项选择中考查。解题技巧：①看到tomorrow, next week, soon等将来时间状语，且动词是位移动词（come/go/leave/arrive/start/fly等），优先考虑现在进行时表将来。②区分三种将来表达：be doing（已安排的计划）、be going to（主观打算/迹象推断）、will（临时决定/一般将来）。③注意：be leaving for（动身去某地）比be going to leave更常用。例：I am leaving for Paris next Monday. 高频考点：be doing表将来与be going to/will的辨析选择。

exam_points.title: 词汇运用
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①amaze/amazed/amazing辨析：amazing修饰物（令人惊叹的），amazed修饰人（感到惊叹的），amaze是动词。例：The amazing news amazed us. / We were amazed at the amazing news. ②apply/application词族：apply v. 申请（apply for sth. / apply to do sth.）；application n. 申请（application form 申请表）；applicant n. 申请人。③official/officer辨析：official指政府官员（也可作形容词"官方的"）；officer指军队或警察中的军官。解题技巧：-ing结尾形容词修饰物（描述事物本身的性质），-ed结尾形容词修饰人（描述人的感受）。

exam_points.title: 旅行计划写作
exam_points.content: 旅行计划/游记是常见写作题型。写作要点：①时态：描述已定行程用现在进行时表将来（We are visiting... / We are staying at...）；描述已完成旅程用过去时。②结构：出发信息→日程安排（Day 1, Day 2...）→景点活动→住宿交通→感受期待。③常用表达：set off 出发；head to 前往；check in 入住；take a tour of 参观；enjoy the view 欣赏风景；try local food 品尝当地美食；book a ticket 订票。④连接词：first, then, after that, finally, in the end。学习提示：行程安排要条理清晰，使用表示顺序的连接词；适当加入个人感受使文章生动。

examples.title: 语法填空（基础题）
examples.question: My flight ______ (take off) at 9:00 tomorrow morning.
examples.analysis: 本题考查现在进行时表将来。分析要点：①时间状语tomorrow morning表示将来。②动词take off是位移动词（起飞），符合"位移动词进行时表将来"的规则。③主语flight是单数，be动词用is。因此填is taking off。注意：也可以用一般现在时takes off表按时刻表发生的将来动作（航班时刻表用一般现在时），但进行时更强调按计划即将发生。
examples.answer: is taking off。位移动词take off的进行时表按计划将来。

examples.title: 词形辨析（中档题）
examples.question: 用amaze的适当形式填空：The view was ______ and we were ______ at it.
examples.analysis: 本题考查amaze的形容词变形及其用法。分析两个空格：①第一空修饰主语the view（物），描述事物本身令人惊叹的性质，用-ing结尾的amazing。②第二空修饰we（人），描述人感受到的惊叹，用-ed结尾的amazed。固定搭配be amazed at sth. 对某事感到惊叹。解题技巧：记住口诀"-ing修饰物，-ed修饰人"。类似用法的词还有：interest/interesting/interested；excite/exciting/excited；surprise/surprising/surprised；bore/boring/bored等。
examples.answer: amazing; amazed。amazing修饰物，amazed修饰人。

examples.title: 将来时态辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：— You've left the light on. — Oh, sorry. I ______ and turn it off now. A. am going B. go C. will go D. have gone
examples.analysis: 本题考查将来时态的辨析。对话语境：对方提醒灯没关，说话人表示歉意并说"我现在去关"。这是临时决定要做的事（之前没有计划），应该用will表示临时决定/即时反应。be going to用于事先计划好的事，不合语境；go和have gone不符合时态要求。解题技巧：will可表"临时决定"，即说话时刚决定的将来动作；be going to表"事先计划"，即说话前已决定的将来动作。这是高考高频考点。
examples.answer: C. will go。临时决定用will，不用be going to。

examples.title: apply词族（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：She decided to apply ______ a scholarship to study abroad and filled in the ______ (apply) form carefully.
examples.analysis: 本题考查apply的搭配和词形变化。第一个空：apply for是固定搭配，意为"申请"，填for。第二个空：需要填名词修饰form，apply的名词形式是application（申请），application form意为"申请表"。解题技巧：①apply for sth. 申请某物（后接申请的对象）；apply to sb. for sth. 向某人申请某物。②apply→application（名词）→applicant（申请人）。注意apply的名词是application而非applyment。
examples.answer: for; application。apply for 申请；application form 申请表。

past_exams.question: My flight ______ (take off) at 9:00 tomorrow morning.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查现在进行时表将来。时间状语tomorrow morning表示将来，动词take off是位移动词（起飞），符合位移动词进行时表将来的规则。
past_exams.answer: is taking off。位移动词take off的进行时表按计划将来。

past_exams.question: The view was ______ (amaze) and we were ______ (amaze) at it.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查amaze的形容词变形。第一空修饰the view（物），用amazing。第二空修饰we（人），用amazed。口诀：-ing修饰物，-ed修饰人。
past_exams.answer: amazing; amazed。amazing修饰物，amazed修饰人。

past_exams.question: She decided to apply ______ a scholarship to study abroad and filled in the ______ (apply) form carefully.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查apply的搭配和词形变化。第一空apply for（申请），填for。第二空apply的名词形式是application（申请表）。
past_exams.answer: for; application。apply for 申请；application form 申请表。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：We arrived at the ancient temple after a long journey. The ______ architecture was breathtaking. Our guide told us that the temple ______ back to the Tang Dynasty.
A. ancient; dated  B. modern; dated  C. ancient; dates  D. modern; dates
past_exams.analysis: 第一空用ancient（古老的）。第二空：date back to（追溯到）通常用一般现在时，因为描述客观事实。选C。
past_exams.answer: C. ancient; dates。ancient指古老的；date back to用一般现在时。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Travelling is more than just visiting famous landmarks. It's about experiencing different cultures, trying local food, and meeting new people. Many travellers say that the most memorable moments are often the unexpected ones — a conversation with a local shop owner, or getting lost in a narrow street and discovering a hidden cafe.
What does the author think is the most valuable part of travelling?
A. Taking photos of famous landmarks.  B. Experiencing unexpected moments.  C. Buying souvenirs for friends.  D. Staying in luxury hotels.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出旅行最难忘的时刻往往是意想不到的。作者认为旅行最有价值的部分是体验意想不到的时刻。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。作者认为旅行最难忘的是意想不到的时刻。

past_exams.question:
— You've left the light on. — Oh, sorry. I ______ (go) and turn it off now.
A. am going  B. go  C. will go  D. have gone
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查将来时态辨析。这是临时决定要做的事，用will表示临时决定。be going to用于事先计划好的事。
past_exams.answer: C. will go。临时决定用will，不用be going to。

past_exams.question: It is amazing ______ the ancient pyramid still stands after thousands of years.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查It is amazing that...句型。It是形式主语，真正主语是that引导的主语从句。
past_exams.answer: that。It is amazing that...中that引导主语从句。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：Planning a trip can be exciting but also overwhelming.
___1___ Decide where you want to go and what you want to see. Research your destination in advance.
___2___ Set a realistic budget for your trip, including transportation, accommodation, and food.
___3___ Book your flights and hotels early to get better prices.
A. Research your destination.  B. Set a budget.  C. Book early.  D. Travel alone.  E. Pack light.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"研究目的地"，对应A。第二段讲"设定预算"，对应B。第三段讲"提前预订"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调研究目的地、设定预算和提前预订。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Ecotourism has become increasingly popular. Unlike traditional tourism, ecotourism aims to minimize its impact on nature. However, some critics argue that even ecotourism can cause harm if not properly managed, as increased foot traffic can still damage delicate ecosystems.
What is the author's attitude towards ecotourism?
A. Completely supportive.  B. Entirely negative.  C. Cautiously optimistic.  D. Uninterested.
past_exams.analysis: 作者既肯定生态旅游的积极面，也指出潜在问题，态度是谨慎乐观的。选C。
past_exams.answer: C。作者既肯定生态旅游的积极面，也指出潜在问题，态度谨慎乐观。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，暑假即将来临，你和家人计划去北京旅游。请你写一篇旅行计划。
范文：
Summer Trip to Beijing
This summer, my family and I are travelling to Beijing for a five-day trip. We are leaving on July 15th by high-speed train.
On the first day, we are visiting the Forbidden City and Tian'anmen Square. The next day, we plan to climb the Great Wall. On the third day, we are heading to the Summer Palace. We will also try some famous Beijing roast duck.
I have been looking forward to this trip for months. I am sure it will be an amazing experience.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查旅行计划写作。①时态正确：描述已定行程用现在进行时表将来（are travelling, are leaving, are visiting）；②结构清晰：出发信息→日程安排→感受期待。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：时态正确、结构清晰、内容完整。

chapters.title: Unit 3 Sports and Fitness 运动与健康
chapters.summary: 话题：体育运动与健康生活。语法：反意疑问句。写作：健康生活方式比较。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: fitness 健康/适合（physical fitness 身体健康）；champion 冠军（championship 冠军赛）；determine 决心/决定（be determined to do 决心做某事）；injured 受伤的（injure v. 伤害；injury n. 伤）；captain 队长；graceful 优雅的；strength 力量（strengthen v. 加强）；failure 失败（succeed v. 成功；success n. 成功）；compete 竞争（compete with/against sb. 与某人竞争；compete for sth. 为……竞争）；pretend 假装（pretend to do sth. 假装做某事）；diet 饮食（be on a diet 节食）；balanced 平衡的（a balanced diet 均衡饮食）。词汇辨析：injure多指意外事故伤害；wound多指刀枪伤；hurt可指身体或情感伤害。compete强调竞争；match强调匹配。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: make it 成功/赶到（口语常用，如Can you make it? 你能来吗？）；work out 锻炼/算出（work out the problem 算出问题）；give up 放弃（give up doing sth. 放弃做某事）；lose weight 减肥（gain weight 增重）；rather than 而不是（连接平行结构）；cut out 戒除/删去（cut out sugar 戒糖）；compare...to... 把……比作（compare...with... 把……与……比较）；make a difference 起作用/有影响。易错提示：rather than连接的两个部分结构要一致（rather than doing A, doing B 或 rather than do A, do B）。make it含义灵活，需根据语境理解。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①Instead of doing..., sb. does... 某人不做……而做……。例：Instead of giving up, she trained harder. 她没有放弃，而是更加努力训练。②The more..., the more... 越……越……。例：The more you practice, the better you will be. 你练习得越多，就越好。注意：前一个the是关系副词，后一个是指示副词；两个比较级结构平行。③It is up to sb. to do sth. 做某事取决于某人。例：It is up to you to decide. 由你决定。学习提示：The more...the more...句型在写作中很实用，可用来表达递进关系，增加语言的丰富性。

knowledge.title: 语法：反意疑问句
knowledge.content: 反意疑问句由"陈述句+附加疑问"构成，基本规则是"前肯后否、前否后肯"，附加疑问部分的动词与主句一致。常规情况：He is a student, isn't he? / You don't like sports, do you? 特殊情况（高频考点）：①let's用shall we（Let's go, shall we?）；let us用will you。②祈使句用will you/won't you（Open the door, will you?）。③含有nothing, nobody, none, few, little, never, hardly, seldom等否定词时，附加疑问用肯定（He has never been there, has he?）。④I think/believe/suppose+宾语从句时，反问与从句主语一致（I think he is right, isn't he?）；若主语不是I则与主句一致。⑤Everything/Nothing/Something作主语时，反问用it（Everything is ready, isn't it?）。⑥含有un-, im-, dis-等否定前缀的词不算否定词，仍用否定反问（He is unhappy, isn't he?）。学习提示：反意疑问句考点集中在特殊情况，务必牢记上述规则。

exam_points.title: 反意疑问句
exam_points.content: 反意疑问句是高考单项选择和语法填空的高频考点。解题技巧：①先判断陈述部分是肯定还是否定——注意隐含否定词（never, hardly, seldom, few, little, nothing, nobody等）使句子变为否定。②确定附加疑问的动词——与主句谓语动词的be/助/情态动词一致，时态也一致。③特殊句型单独记忆：let's→shall we；祈使句→will you；I think从句→跟从句变。④否定前缀（un-, im-, dis-）不改变句子肯定性质。例：She dislikes sports, doesn't she?（dislike虽有dis-但仍是肯定句）。高频易错：few修饰可数名词表否定，a few表肯定；little修饰不可数名词表否定，a little表肯定。

exam_points.title: 词汇辨析
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①compete/competition/competitive：compete v. 竞争；competition n. 竞争/比赛；competitive adj. 有竞争力的；competitor n. 竞争者。②injure/wound/hurt：injure多指意外事故造成伤害（injured in an accident）；wound多指刀、枪等武器伤害（wounded in the war）；hurt最常用，可指身体或感情伤害（hurt one's feelings）。③strength/power/energy：strength指体力或力量；power指权力或能量；energy指精力或能源。解题技巧：根据语境选择，运动受伤用injure，战争受伤用wound，感情受伤用hurt。

exam_points.title: 健康话题写作
exam_points.content: 健康生活方式是高考写作热门话题。写作要点：①结构：引出话题→分析现状/问题→提出建议→总结呼吁。②比较不同生活方式：用compare...with..., while, however, on the contrary等连接词进行对比。③常用表达：keep fit 保持健康；build up one's body 强身健体；a balanced diet 均衡饮食；regular exercise 规律运动；stay up late 熬夜；be addicted to 沉迷于；mental health 心理健康。④建议句式：It is advisable to do...; We'd better do...; Only by doing... can we do...。学习提示：多用比较句式（The more...the more..., compared with, rather than）使文章有层次感。

examples.title: 反意疑问句（基础题）
examples.question: 完成反意疑问句：He has never been to the gym, ______?
examples.analysis: 本题考查含否定词的反意疑问句。分析要点：①陈述部分有never（从不），这是否定词，使陈述部分变为否定句。②根据"前否后肯"原则，附加疑问部分用肯定形式。③陈述部分谓语是has（助动词，构成现在完成时），附加疑问也用has。④主语是he，附加疑问用he。因此填has he。解题技巧：遇到never, nothing, nobody, hardly, seldom, few, little等否定词时，陈述部分就是否定的，附加疑问用肯定。
examples.answer: has he。前句有never否定词，反问部分用肯定。

examples.title: 句型翻译（中档题）
examples.question: 翻译：你锻炼得越多，就越健康。
examples.analysis: 本题考查The more...the more...句型。分析结构："越……越……"用The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...结构。"锻炼得越多"用The more you work out（more修饰work out，表示更多锻炼）；"越健康"用the healthier you will be（healthier是healthy的比较级）。完整句子：The more you work out, the healthier you will be. 注意：此句型中前半句相当于条件从句，后半句是主句，时态通常前后一致或前一般现在时后将来时。学习提示：此句型还可扩展为The + 比较级+主谓, the + 比较级+主谓，如The harder you work, the more you will earn.
examples.answer: The more you work out, the healthier you will be.

examples.title: 反意疑问句特殊句型（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 完成反意疑问句：I don't think he will come to the party, ______?
examples.analysis: 本题考查I think/believe/suppose/imagine+宾语从句的反意疑问句特殊规则。分析要点：①当主句是I think/believe/suppose等且主句主语是第一人称时，反意疑问部分要与从句的主语和谓语保持一致（即跟从句变）。②从句是he will come（肯定），但主句有don't（否定），需要考虑否定转移——I don't think he will come实际上否定的是从句（我认为他不会来），所以从句实质上是否定的。③根据"前否后肯"原则，附加疑问用肯定。④从句主语是he，助动词是will。因此填will he。解题技巧：I think句型的反意疑问句，先看主句是否定还是肯定（I don't think算否定，I think算肯定），再跟从句主语和动词变。
examples.answer: will he。I don't think句型反问部分与从句一致，否定转移后从句为否定，反问用肯定。

examples.title: 词汇辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The soldier was seriously ______ in the battle and was sent to hospital immediately. A. injured B. wounded C. hurt D. harmed
examples.analysis: 本题考查表示"受伤"的近义词辨析。分析语境：关键词soldier（士兵）和battle（战斗），说明是在战争中受的伤。四个选项的区别：injured多指意外事故造成的伤害；wounded多指刀、枪等武器在战斗中造成的伤害；hurt最常用，可指身体或感情伤害，程度较轻；harmed指造成损害，不一定指身体伤害。根据语境（士兵在战斗中受伤），应选wounded。解题技巧：看到battle/war/weapon等词，优先选wounded；看到accident/car crash等词，优先选injured。
examples.answer: B. wounded。wound多指战斗中刀枪造成的伤，符合soldier和battle的语境。

past_exams.question: 完成反意疑问句：He has never been to the gym, ______?
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查含否定词的反意疑问句。陈述部分有never（否定词），根据"前否后肯"原则，附加疑问部分用肯定形式。陈述部分谓语是has，附加疑问也用has。
past_exams.answer: has he。前句有never否定词，反问部分用肯定。

past_exams.question: The more you practice, the ______ (good) you will become at sports.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查The more...the more...句型。good的比较级是better。
past_exams.answer: better。The more...the + 比较级...句型，good的比较级为better。

past_exams.question: Let's go for a run after school, ______?
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查反意疑问句特殊句型。Let's引导的祈使句，附加疑问部分用shall we。
past_exams.answer: shall we。Let's引导的祈使句反问用shall we。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：Lisa was a determined young athlete. Although she was ______ in a serious accident last year, she never gave up. She worked out every day and followed a strict ______ to rebuild her strength.
A. injured; diet  B. wounded; diet  C. injured; menu  D. hurt; menu
past_exams.analysis: 第一空："在事故中受伤"用injured（injure多指意外事故伤害）。第二空："严格的饮食计划"用diet。选A。
past_exams.answer: A. injured; diet。injure指意外事故受伤；diet指饮食计划。

past_exams.question: 完成反意疑问句：I don't think he will come to the party, ______?
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查I think句型的反意疑问句。I don't think he will come中否定转移到从句，从句实质否定，反问用肯定。从句主语he，助动词will。
past_exams.answer: will he。I don't think句型反问与从句一致，否定转移后从句为否定，反问用肯定。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Regular exercise is essential for maintaining good health. Studies have shown that people who exercise at least 30 minutes a day have a lower risk of heart disease. Moreover, exercise releases endorphins, which are natural mood boosters. However, experts warn that overtraining can lead to injuries.
What does the passage suggest about exercise?
A. More exercise is always better.  B. Beginners should start slowly and increase gradually.  C. Only intense exercise is beneficial.  D. Exercise is only good for physical health.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出过度训练会导致受伤，建议初学者慢慢开始并逐渐增加强度。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。文章建议初学者慢慢开始并逐渐增加运动强度。

past_exams.question:
The soldier was seriously ______ in the battle and was sent to hospital immediately.
A. injured  B. wounded  C. hurt  D. harmed
past_exams.analysis: 关键词soldier和battle，说明在战争中受的伤。wounded多指刀枪等武器在战斗中造成的伤害。
past_exams.answer: B. wounded。wound多指战斗中刀枪造成的伤，符合soldier和battle的语境。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to build a healthy lifestyle?
___1___ Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise every day.
___2___ Eat a variety of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Avoid too much sugar.
___3___ Getting 7-8 hours of sleep each night is crucial.
A. Exercise regularly.  B. Eat a balanced diet.  C. Get enough sleep.  D. Drink more coffee.  E. Work harder.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"每天至少30分钟运动"，对应A。第二段讲"吃各种水果蔬菜"，对应B。第三段讲"7-8小时睡眠"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调规律运动、均衡饮食和充足睡眠。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The concept of 'fitness' has evolved over the years. In the past, fitness was primarily associated with athletic performance. Today, however, fitness is viewed more holistically, encompassing not just physical strength but also mental well-being, flexibility, and endurance.
How has the concept of fitness changed?
A. It has shifted from holistic to athletic focus.  B. It has become more narrowly defined.  C. It now includes mental well-being, not just physical strength.  D. It is no longer important in modern society.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出过去fitness主要与运动表现相关，如今则更全面，包括心理健康、柔韧性和耐力。选C。
past_exams.answer: C。健身概念现在更全面，包括心理健康而不仅仅是体力。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你的朋友王明最近体重增加，经常感到疲惫。请你给他写一封信，比较两种不同的生活方式，并建议他选择健康的生活方式。
范文：Dear Wang Ming,
I'm concerned about your recent weight gain and tiredness.
Compared with your current lifestyle, a healthy one can make a big difference. Instead of staying up late and eating junk food, you'd better go to bed early and keep a balanced diet. Rather than spending all day in front of the computer, why not work out for 30 minutes every day? The more you exercise, the healthier you will become.
Only by changing your habits can you regain your energy. Let's start working out together!
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查健康生活方式比较写作。①使用比较句式（Compared with..., Instead of..., Rather than..., The more...the more...）；②使用倒装句（Only by...can you...）提升档次。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：比较结构使用、建议具体、语言流畅。

chapters.title: Unit 4 Natural Disasters 自然灾害
chapters.summary: 话题：自然灾害与救援。语法：限制性定语从句（关系代词）。写作：灾害报道/新闻报道。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: disaster 灾难（natural disaster 自然灾害）；earthquake 地震；rescue 救援（rescue sb. from... 从……救出某人）；shelter 庇护所/避难所（take shelter 躲避）；survive 幸存/存活（survive sth. 从……中幸存；survival n. 幸存；survivor n. 幸存者）；destroy 破坏（destruction n. 破坏）；affect 影响（effect n. 影响；have an effect on 对……有影响）；effort 努力（make efforts to do 努力做某事）；emergency 紧急情况（in an emergency 在紧急情况下）；supply 供应/物资（supplies 生活物资）；summary 摘要/总结（summarize v. 总结）；significant 重大的/有意义的（significance n. 重要性）。词汇辨析：destroy强调彻底毁坏无法修复；damage指部分损坏可修复；ruin指毁坏使之失去价值。affect是动词，effect是名词。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: in ruins 严重受损/成为废墟（The city was in ruins. 城市化为废墟）；as if 仿佛/好像（后接虚拟语气或陈述语气）；come to an end 结束；in shock 震惊/处于震惊状态；dig out 掘出/挖出；sweep away 冲走/扫除；suffer from 遭受（suffer from floods 遭受洪灾）；provide sth. for sb. = provide sb. with sth. 为某人提供某物。易错提示：as if后接虚拟语气时，对现在情况假设用过去时（were），对过去情况假设用过去完成时。suffer from后接疾病或灾害；suffer直接接痛苦、损失等。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①It seemed as if... 似乎好像……。例：It seemed as if the world was coming to an end. 似乎世界末日要来了。②There were... doing sth. 有……正在做某事。例：There were people waiting to be rescued. 有人等着被救。③The number of... who/which... ……的数量（后接定语从句）。例：The number of people who lost their homes reached 10,000. 失去家园的人数达到一万。注意：a number of后接复数名词谓语用复数；the number of后接复数名词谓语用单数。

knowledge.title: 语法：限制性定语从句（关系代词）
knowledge.content: 定语从句是高中语法核心。关系代词用法：①who指人，在从句中作主语或宾语。例：The man who lives next door is a doctor. ②whom指人，作宾语（口语可用who替代，可省略）。例：The girl (whom) I met yesterday is his sister. ③which指物，作主语或宾语（作宾语可省略）。例：The book which is on the table is mine. ④that指人或物，作主语或宾语（作宾语可省略）。例：The man that/who told me the news has left. ⑤whose表所属关系（人或物均可），作定语。例：The boy whose father is a teacher is my friend. The house whose roof was damaged has been repaired. 只用that不用which的情况（高频考点）：①先行词被最高级修饰（the best book that I've read）；②先行词被序数词修饰（the first place that we visited）；③先行词是不定代词all, everything, anything, nothing, none, little, few等（Everything that can be done has been done）；④先行词被the only, the very, the same等修饰；⑤先行词同时包含人和物（The man and his dog that were walking in the park...）。只用which不用that的情况：①非限制性定语从句中；②介词之后。学习提示：判断关系代词的步骤——先找先行词（人/物），再判断关系词在从句中作什么成分（主语/宾语），最后选择合适的关系代词。

exam_points.title: 定语从句关系代词
exam_points.content: 定语从句是高考必考语法点。解题技巧：①第一步找先行词——确定先行词是人还是物。②第二步判断关系词在从句中的成分——将先行词代入从句，看是作主语、宾语还是定语。作主语用who/that（人）或which/that（物）；作宾语用whom/who/that（人）或which/that（物），可省略；作定语用whose。③第三步检查特殊情况——是否有只用that或只用which的限制条件。例：This is the most beautiful city ___ I have ever visited. 先行词city被最高级修饰，只用that。高频考点：that与which的辨析、whose的用法、关系代词的省略。

exam_points.title: 词汇运用
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①destroy/ruin/damage辨析：destroy指彻底破坏、无法修复（The earthquake destroyed the whole village）；ruin指毁坏使失去价值或用途（The rain ruined my plan）；damage指部分损害、可修复（The car was damaged in the accident）。②survive/survival/survivor词族：survive v. 幸存（及物动词，直接接宾语，如survive the earthquake）；survival n. 幸存；survivor n. 幸存者。③affect/effect：affect是动词"影响"；effect是名词"影响"（have an effect on = affect）。解题技巧：survive是及物动词，不加from或in，直接接灾害名词。

exam_points.title: 新闻写作
exam_points.content: 新闻报道是应用文写作题型。写作要点：①结构：标题→导语（时间、地点、事件概述）→正文（详细经过、伤亡损失、救援情况）→结尾（后续影响、意义）。②新闻要素：When, Where, Who, What, Why, How（5W1H）。③时态：以一般过去时为主，描述现状用一般现在时。④语言特点：客观、简洁、准确，避免主观感情色彩。⑤常用表达：A powerful earthquake struck/hit... at...；measuring... on the Richter scale；causing... deaths and injuries；rescue teams were sent to...；thousands of people were left homeless。学习提示：新闻写作第一句要包含最重要的信息（导语），然后按重要性递减顺序展开（倒金字塔结构）。

examples.title: 定语从句基础（基础题）
examples.question: 用关系代词填空：The earthquake ______ struck the city caused great damage.
examples.analysis: 本题考查定语从句关系代词的选择。分析步骤：①找先行词——earthquake（地震），指物。②判断关系词在从句中的成分——将earthquake代入从句"___ struck the city"，earthquake作struck的主语。③选择关系代词——先行词指物且作主语，可用that或which。④检查限制条件——无特殊限制（非最高级/序数词/不定代词修饰），that和which都可以。因此填that或which。
examples.answer: that / which。先行词earthquake指物，在从句中作主语。

examples.title: that与which辨析（中档题）
examples.question: This is the most terrible disaster ______ I have ever experienced.（填关系代词）
examples.analysis: 本题考查只用that不用which的特殊情况。分析步骤：①找先行词——disaster（灾难），指物。②判断成分——将disaster代入从句"___ I have ever experienced"，disaster作experienced的宾语。③正常情况下指物作宾语可用that/which或省略。④检查限制条件——先行词disaster被最高级the most terrible修饰，属于"先行词被最高级修饰只用that"的情况。因此只能填that，不能用which，也不能省略。解题技巧：看到the most/best/worst等最高级修饰先行词，直接选that。
examples.answer: that。先行词被最高级the most terrible修饰，只用that。

examples.title: whose用法（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 用关系代词填空：The boy ______ father is a rescue worker saved three people in the flood.
examples.analysis: 本题考查whose引导的定语从句。分析步骤：①找先行词——boy（男孩），指人。②判断成分——从句是"___ father is a rescue worker"，空格处需要表示"他的"（boy's），修饰father，作定语。③选择关系代词——whose表所属关系，作定语，既可指人也可指物。因此填whose，意为"那个男孩（的父亲是救援工人）"。whose = of whom the / the boy's。解题技巧：whose在定语从句中作定语，表示"……的"，后面紧跟它修饰的名词。whose既可指人也可指物，如The house whose roof is red is mine.
examples.answer: whose。先行词boy指人，whose在从句中作father的定语，表所属关系。

examples.title: 词汇辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The flood ______ the old bridge, but engineers said it could be repaired. A. destroyed B. ruined C. damaged D. broke
examples.analysis: 本题考查表示"破坏"的近义词辨析。分析语境：关键词"but engineers said it could be repaired"（但工程师说可以修复），说明桥梁只是部分受损，可以修复。四个选项：destroyed指彻底破坏、无法修复，与后文"可修复"矛盾；ruined指毁坏使之失去价值，也偏彻底；damaged指部分损害、可修复，符合语境；broke指打破、断裂，不正式。因此选damaged。解题技巧：根据后文线索判断损害程度——可修复选damage/damaged，不可修复选destroy/destroyed。
examples.answer: C. damaged。damage指部分损害可修复，符合后文"可修复"的语境。

past_exams.question: The earthquake ______ struck the city caused great damage.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查定语从句关系代词。先行词earthquake指物，在从句中作struck的主语，用that或which。
past_exams.answer: that / which。先行词earthquake指物，在从句中作主语。

past_exams.question: This is the most terrible disaster ______ I have ever experienced.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查只用that不用which的情况。先行词disaster被最高级the most terrible修饰，只用that。
past_exams.answer: that。先行词被最高级the most terrible修饰，只用that。

past_exams.question: The number of people ______ lost their homes reached 10,000.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查定语从句关系代词。先行词people指人，在从句中作lost的主语，用who或that。
past_exams.answer: who / that。先行词people指人，在从句中作主语。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：When the earthquake hit, the entire city was in ______. Buildings collapsed, roads were cracked. Rescue teams were sent immediately to ______ those trapped under the ruins. It was one of the most devastating natural ______ in the country's history.
A. shock; rescue; disasters  B. peace; save; events  C. shock; rescue; events  D. peace; save; disasters
past_exams.analysis: 第一空："陷入震惊"用in shock。第二空："救援被困的人"用rescue。第三空："自然灾害"用natural disasters。选A。
past_exams.answer: A. shock; rescue; disasters。in shock处于震惊；rescue救援；natural disasters自然灾害。

past_exams.question:
The flood ______ the old bridge, but engineers said it could be repaired.
A. destroyed  B. ruined  C. damaged  D. broke
past_exams.analysis: 关键词"but engineers said it could be repaired"（可以修复），说明桥梁只是部分受损。damaged指部分损害可修复。
past_exams.answer: C. damaged。damage指部分损害可修复，符合后文"可修复"的语境。

past_exams.question: The boy ______ father is a rescue worker saved three people in the flood.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查whose引导的定语从句。先行词boy指人，从句中空格表"他的"，修饰father，作定语。whose表所属关系。
past_exams.answer: whose。先行词boy指人，whose在从句中作father的定语，表所属关系。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：On March 11, 2011, a massive earthquake struck Japan, triggering a devastating tsunami. The waves, some reaching 40 meters in height, swept away entire towns. Over 15,000 people lost their lives, and more than 200,000 were left homeless.
How many people were left homeless by the disaster?
A. Over 15,000.  B. More than 200,000.  C. 40,000.  D. 11,000.
past_exams.analysis: 文章明确指出"Over 15,000 people lost their lives"和"more than 200,000 were left homeless"。题目问无家可归的人数，选B。
past_exams.answer: B。文章指出超过20万人无家可归。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：What should you do during an earthquake?
___1___ Drop to the ground, take cover under a sturdy table, and hold on until the shaking stops.
___2___ Stay away from windows, glass, and heavy furniture that could fall on you.
___3___ If you are outdoors, move to an open area away from buildings and power lines.
A. Drop, cover, and hold on.  B. Stay away from hazards.  C. Move to open areas outdoors.  D. Run outside immediately.  E. Use elevators to escape.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"趴下、掩护、坚持"，对应A。第二段讲"远离危险物"，对应B。第三段讲"移到开阔区域"，对应C。D和E与地震安全建议相反。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调掩护躲避、远离危险物和移至开阔区域。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The 2008 Wenchuan earthquake was one of the most destructive natural disasters in China's history. Measuring 8.0 on the Richter scale, it affected over 46 million people across 10 provinces. What made this earthquake particularly devastating was not just its magnitude, but also the time it struck — 2:28 PM on a Monday afternoon, when schools were in session.
Why was the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake particularly devastating?
A. It was the strongest earthquake ever recorded.  B. It struck when schools were in session.  C. It affected only one province.  D. It happened at night when people were sleeping.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出"What made this earthquake particularly devastating was...the time it struck — 2:28 PM...when schools were in session"。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。文章指出地震发生时学校正在上课，使灾情特别严重。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是校报英语记者，请根据以下信息写一篇关于某市地震的新闻报道：时间2024年6月15日凌晨3:00；震级5.8级；约200人受伤，无人死亡；救援队已赶赴现场。
范文：
A 5.8-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes City
At 3:00 a.m. on June 15, 2024, a 5.8-magnitude earthquake struck a city, causing widespread damage. Several buildings collapsed and approximately 200 people were injured. Fortunately, no deaths have been reported so far.
Rescue teams were immediately sent to the affected areas. Tents and supplies have been provided for those who lost their homes. The local government has set up temporary shelters.
Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查新闻写作。①结构：标题→导语→正文→结尾；②新闻要素5W1H齐全；③时态以一般过去时为主，描述现状用现在完成时；④语言客观简洁。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：新闻要素齐全、时态正确、语言客观。

chapters.title: Unit 5 Languages Around the World 世界语言
chapters.summary: 话题：世界语言与汉字发展。语法：限制性定语从句（关系副词与介词+关系代词）。写作：语言学习经验。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: symbol 符号/象征（a symbol of ...的象征）；classic 经典的（classical music 古典音乐）；regard 看作/认为（regard...as... 把……看作）；variety 多样性（a variety of 各种各样；vary v. 变化；various adj. 各种各样的）；major 主要的/专业（major in 主修）；native 本地的/母语的（native language 母语）；attitude 态度（attitude to/towards 对……的态度）；official 官方的（official language 官方语言）；appreciate 欣赏/感激（appreciate doing sth. 感激做某事）；demand 要求/需求（meet the demand 满足需求；in demand 有需求）；vocabulary 词汇（不可数名词）。词汇辨析：classic指经典的、优秀的；classical指古典的。regard...as强调主观看法；treat...as强调行为上的对待。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: regard...as... 把……看作（= consider...as/think of...as）；refer to 指的是/提到/参考（refer to the dictionary 查词典）；date back to 追溯到（无被动语态，常用一般现在时）；be based on 基于（based on... 过去分词短语作状语）；no matter 不管/无论（no matter what/when/where/who/how）；point of view 观点（= viewpoint）；depend on 依赖/取决于（= rely on）。易错提示：date back to后接过去时间，常与一般现在时连用，不能用被动语态。refer to后接名词或动名词。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①even though/if 即使（引导让步状语从句，不与but连用）。例：Even though it was raining, he went out. 即使下雨，他还是出去了。②no matter + 疑问词 = 疑问词-ever，表"无论……"。例：No matter what happens, I'll support you. = Whatever happens, I'll support you. ③the way (in which/that) + 定语从句。例：I don't like the way (that/in which) he talks. 我不喜欢他说话的方式。注意：the way后定语从句的引导词可用that, in which或省略，但不能用how。

knowledge.title: 语法：关系副词与介词+关系代词
knowledge.content: 关系副词用法：①when表时间，在从句中作时间状语，相当于at/in/on which。例：I remember the day when (= on which) I first came to this school. ②where表地点，作地点状语，相当于in/at/on which。例：This is the room where (= in which) I was born. ③why表原因，作原因状语，相当于for which。例：This is the reason why (= for which) he was late. 介词+关系代词：①which指物，whom指人，放在介词后。②介词的确定方法：a) 根据从句动词搭配——The person to whom I talked is my teacher.（talk to sb.）b) 根据先行词搭配——The year in which he was born was 1990.（in the year）c) 根据从句表达的语义。③注意：介词+关系代词结构中，关系代词不可省略，不可用that。关系副词与关系代词的区分（高频考点）：关键是看关系词在从句中作什么成分。作主语或宾语用关系代词（who/which/that）；作状语用关系副词（when/where/why）。判断方法：将先行词代入从句，如果需要加介词才能说得通，说明关系词作状语，用关系副词。例：This is the school ___ I studied. → I studied in the school.（需要介词in）→ 用where。This is the school ___ I visited. → I visited the school.（不需要介词）→ 用which/that。学习提示：定语从句的关键在于判断关系词在从句中的成分，这是解题的核心。

exam_points.title: 关系副词
exam_points.content: 关系副词是定语从句的核心考点。解题技巧：①判断关系词在从句中的成分——将先行词代入从句，看是否需要加介词。需要介词→作状语→用关系副词when/where/why；不需要介词→作主宾→用关系代词who/which/that。②根据先行词选择关系副词：先行词表时间用when，表地点用where，表原因（reason）用why。③关系副词可替换为介词+which：when=at/in/on which, where=in/at which, why=for which。④注意：先行词是situation, case, point, stage等抽象名词表示"在……情况下/阶段"时，也用where。例：He has reached a point where he must make a decision. 高频考点：when/where/why的选择以及与关系代词的辨析。

exam_points.title: 介词+关系代词
exam_points.content: 介词+关系代词是高考难点。解题技巧：①确定介词的三种方法：a) 看从句动词搭配（The girl with whom I went shopping is my sister. → go shopping with sb.）；b) 看先行词搭配（The day on which I arrived was Monday. → on the day）；c) 看整体语义。②which指物，whom指人，介词后不能用that。③介词+which可替换为关系副词：in/at/on which → when/where；for which → why。④固定搭配中的介词不可提前：listen to, look at, take care of等短语动词的介词一般不提前。例：This is the pen I'm looking for.（介词for不提前，因为look for是固定短语）。

exam_points.title: 词汇与句型
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①no matter与疑问词-ever的转换：no matter what = whatever; no matter when = whenever。但whatever等可引导名词性从句而no matter what不能。②regard...as... = consider...as... = think of...as... = look on...as... 都表示"把……看作"。③appreciate后接动名词不接不定式：I appreciate your helping me. ④demand后接从句用虚拟语气（should + 动词原形）。解题技巧：no matter + 疑问词只能引导让步状语从句；疑问词-ever既可引导让步状语从句（=no matter+疑问词），又可引导名词性从句。

examples.title: 关系副词（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：This is the school ______ I studied for three years.
examples.analysis: 本题考查关系副词where的用法。分析步骤：①找先行词——school（学校），表地点。②判断关系词在从句中的成分——将school代入从句"I studied ___ for three years"，需要加介词in/at（I studied in/at the school），说明关系词作状语。③选择关系词——先行词表地点，关系词作地点状语，用where（= in/at which）。因此填where。解题技巧：将先行词代入从句，如果需要加介词才能说得通，说明作状语，用关系副词。
examples.answer: where。先行词school表地点，从句缺地点状语。

examples.title: 介词+关系代词（中档题）
examples.question: 填空：The person ______ ______ I talked is our English teacher.
examples.analysis: 本题考查介词+关系代词结构。分析步骤：①找先行词——person（人），指人。②判断从句动词搭配——talk to sb.（与某人交谈），动词talk后需要介词to。③介词提前到关系代词前——to + whom。④指人用whom，不能用who或that（介词后不用that）。因此填to; whom。解题技巧：①找从句动词的固定搭配确定介词（talk to sb. → to）。②介词后指人用whom，指物用which，均不能用that。
examples.answer: to; whom。talk to sb.搭配，介词用to，指人用whom。

examples.title: 关系代词与关系副词辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：I'll never forget the days ______ we spent together in the summer camp. A. that B. when C. what D. who
examples.analysis: 本题考查关系代词与关系副词的辨析，是高考高频考点。分析步骤：①找先行词——days（日子），表时间。②判断关系词在从句中的成分——将days代入从句"we spent ___ together"，spent是及物动词，spent后直接接days（spent days together），不需要介词，说明关系词作宾语。③选择关系词——作宾语且先行词指物（时间概念），用that或which，可省略。选项中有that。④when作时间状语不正确，因为此处关系词作宾语而非状语。因此选A. that。解题技巧：不要看到时间先行词就选when，必须先判断成分。如果从句缺宾语用that/which，缺状语才用when。
examples.answer: A. that。先行词days作spent的宾语，用that（也可用which或省略）。

examples.title: no matter句型转换（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 句型转换：No matter how hard it is, I will never give up.（用however改写）→ ______ ______ it is, I will never give up.
examples.analysis: 本题考查no matter how与however的转换。no matter how + adj./adv. + 主谓 = however + adj./adv. + 主谓。原句No matter how hard it is中，hard是形容词作表语。转换为However hard it is。解题技巧：①no matter what = whatever; no matter when = whenever; no matter where = wherever; no matter how = however。②注意however后直接跟形容词或副词，而no matter how也是直接跟。③whatever/whenever/wherever/however除了引导让步状语从句（=no matter...）外，还能引导名词性从句，但no matter...只能引导状语从句。
examples.answer: However hard。However = no matter how，后接形容词hard。

past_exams.question: This is the school ______ I studied for three years.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查关系副词where。先行词school表地点，从句需要加介词in/at，说明关系词作状语，用where。
past_exams.answer: where。先行词school表地点，从句缺地点状语。

past_exams.question: The person ______ ______ I talked is our English teacher.（填两个词）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查介词+关系代词。先行词person指人，从句动词talk搭配talk to sb.，介词to提前。介词后指人用whom。
past_exams.answer: to; whom。talk to sb.搭配，介词用to，指人用whom。

past_exams.question: This is the reason ______ he was late for school.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查关系副词why。先行词reason表原因，从句需要加介词for，说明关系词作原因状语，用why。
past_exams.answer: why。先行词reason表原因，从句缺原因状语。

past_exams.question:
I'll never forget the days ______ we spent together in the summer camp.
A. that  B. when  C. what  D. who
past_exams.analysis: 先行词days表时间，但将days代入从句"we spent ___ together"，spent是及物动词，不需要介词，说明关系词作宾语。作宾语用that/which。
past_exams.answer: A. that。先行词days作spent的宾语，用that。

past_exams.question: No matter how hard it is, I will never give up.（用however改写）→ ______ ______ it is, I will never give up.
past_exams.analysis: no matter how = however，后接形容词或副词。原句hard是形容词，转换为However hard。
past_exams.answer: However hard。However = no matter how，后接形容词hard。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：Chinese characters have a history dating back thousands of years. They are not just a tool for communication but also a ______ of Chinese culture. The ______ of these symbols can be traced to ancient pictographs.
A. symbol; origin  B. sign; source  C. symbol; source  D. sign; origin
past_exams.analysis: 第一空："文化的象征"用symbol。第二空："符号的起源"用origin。选A。
past_exams.answer: A. symbol; origin。symbol指象征；origin指起源。

past_exams.question: ______ (regard) as one of the most beautiful languages in the world, French is studied by millions of people.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查regard...as...的被动形式和过去分词作状语。French与regard是被动关系，用过去分词Regarded。
past_exams.answer: Regarded。French与regard为被动关系，用过去分词作状语。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.
___1___ Immersion is key. Try to surround yourself with the language through music, movies, and conversations.
___2___ Don't just memorize isolated words. Learn words in context and in phrases.
___3___ Make mistakes and learn from them.
A. Immerse yourself in the language.  B. Learn vocabulary in context.  C. Practice speaking without fear.  D. Study grammar rules only.  E. Translate everything word by word.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"沉浸式学习"，对应A。第二段讲"在语境中学习词汇"，对应B。第三段讲"不怕犯错练习口语"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调沉浸式学习、语境学习和大胆练习口语。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The Chinese writing system is one of the oldest continuously used writing systems in the world. Unlike alphabetic languages, Chinese characters represent meaning. This unique feature has allowed the written language to unite speakers of different dialects across China. This is why the Chinese writing system is often regarded as a cultural bond that has kept the nation united for thousands of years.
Why is the Chinese writing system considered a cultural bond?
A. Because it is the oldest writing system in the world.  B. Because it unites speakers of different dialects through written characters.  C. Because it is easier to learn than alphabetic languages.  D. Because it uses letters to represent sounds.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出汉字表意而非表音，使不同方言区的人能通过书写相互理解，因此被视为维系国家团结的文化纽带。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。汉字通过书面文字统一了不同方言的使用者。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"我的英语学习经验"的文章。请你写一篇短文分享你的英语学习经验。
范文：
My English Learning Experience
Learning English has been an amazing journey for me. First, I regard reading as the most effective way to expand my vocabulary. Instead of memorizing isolated words, I prefer to learn new words in context. Second, I refer to English-English dictionaries whenever possible, which forces me to think in English. Third, no matter how busy I am, I spend at least 30 minutes every day listening to English podcasts.
In short, learning English is not about memorizing rules but about using the language in real situations.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查语言学习经验写作。①使用核心词汇（regard...as, refer to, no matter how, instead of）；②结构清晰（引言→分条经验→总结）；③语言地道自然。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：核心词汇使用、结构清晰、经验具体。

chapters.title: Unit 1 Cultural Heritage 文化遗产
chapters.summary: 话题：文化遗产保护（以阿斯旺大坝神庙搬迁为例）。语法：限制性定语从句（复习）。写作：保护文化遗产倡议。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: heritage 遗产（cultural heritage 文化遗产；world heritage 世界遗产）；temple 寺庙；preserve 保护/保存（preserve sth. from... 保护某物免受……；preservation n. 保护）；promote 促进/推广（promote cultural exchange 促进文化交流）；balance 平衡（keep a balance between A and B 在A和B之间保持平衡）；protest 抗议（protest against sth. 抗议某事）；committee 委员会；establish 建立/设立（= set up/found）；limit 限制（limit sth. to... 把……限制在……）；conduct 进行/实施（conduct a survey 进行调查）；document 文件/记录（v. 记录）。词汇辨析：preserve强调保持原样不改变；protect强调防止受到伤害；conserve强调节约使用、合理利用。establish强调正式建立，较正式；set up较口语化。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: give way to 让步于/被……取代（The old buildings gave way to new ones. 旧建筑被新建筑取代）；turn to 求助于/转向（turn to sb. for help 向某人求助）；take apart 拆开（take apart the machine 拆开机器）；piece by piece 一块块地/逐渐地；contribute to 有助于/导致（to是介词，后接名词或动名词）；be likely to 可能（It is likely that... = sb./sth. is likely to do...）；in turn 依次/反过来。易错提示：contribute to中to是介词，后接动名词。give way to表"让步"时主语是被取代的事物。turn to有多种含义（翻到、求助于、转向），需根据语境判断。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①Not only...but also... 不仅……而且……。当Not only置于句首时，主句使用部分倒装（助动词/情态动词/be动词提到主语前）。例：Not only does he study hard, but he also helps others. 他不仅努力学习，还帮助别人。②There comes a time when... ……的时候到来了。例：There comes a time when we must make a choice. 我们必须做出选择的时候到了。③It is worthwhile to do/doing... 值得做……。例：It is worthwhile to visit the museum. 参观博物馆是值得的。注意：worthwhile后可接to do或doing；worth后接动名词（be worth doing）；worthy后接of being done或to be done。

knowledge.title: 语法：定语从句复习
knowledge.content: 本单元综合运用关系代词与关系副词，并初步接触非限制性定语从句。限制性定语从句：对先行词起限定作用，不可缺少，不用逗号隔开。关系词选择：先行词指人用who/whom/that/whose；指物用which/that/whose；作状语用when/where/why。非限制性定语从句：①用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词进行补充说明，去掉后主句意思仍完整。②不能用that引导，指人用who/whom，指物用which。③which可指代整个主句。例：He passed the exam, which made his parents happy. 他通过了考试，这让父母很高兴。（which指代"他通过考试"这件事）④关系词不可省略。学习提示：限制性定语从句与主句关系密切，非限制性定语从句是补充说明。有逗号隔开的定语从句，不用that。

exam_points.title: 定语从句综合
exam_points.content: 定语从句是高考必考语法点，综合考查限制性与非限制性定语从句。解题技巧：①先判断是限制性还是非限制性——有无逗号隔开。②限制性定语从句根据先行词和成分选择关系词。③非限制性定语从句不能用that，指人用who/whom，指物用which。④which可指代整个主句（逗号后用which）。⑤whose既可用于限制性也可用于非限制性。例：He is my best friend, whose father is a famous writer. 高频考点：逗号后不能用that；which指代整个主句；非限制性定语从句中关系词不可省略。

exam_points.title: 倒装句
exam_points.content: Not only...but also...置于句首引起部分倒装是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①Not only置于句首时，not only所在的分句部分倒装（助动词/be/情态动词提到主语前），but also所在的分句不倒装。②倒装形式：一般现在时加do/does/did；一般过去时加did；有be/情态动词的直接提前。例：Not only did he study hard, but he also passed the exam. ③但also可省略，也可用as well代替。④Not only...but also连接两个主语时不倒装（Not only you but also I am interested in English.）。学习提示：倒装的关键是把助动词提到主语前面，没有助动词就加do/does/did。

exam_points.title: 应用文写作
exam_points.content: 倡议书是常见应用文写作题型。写作要点：①结构：标题→称呼→引言（提出倡议背景和目的）→正文（具体倡议内容，分条列出）→结尾（呼吁行动）→落款。②常用句式：It is high time that we did sth.；I suggest/recommend that we (should) do sth.；Let's join hands to do sth.；Every one of us should take the responsibility to do sth.；Only by doing... can we do...。③连接词：First, Second, Besides, What's more, Finally。④语气：热情有力，有号召力和感染力。学习提示：倡议书要有明确的目标和具体的行动建议，结尾要有强有力的呼吁。

examples.title: 倒装句（基础题）
examples.question: 用倒装改写：Not only ______ ______ (he/protect) the temple, but he also raised funds for it.
examples.analysis: 本题考查Not only置于句首的部分倒装。分析步骤：①Not only置于句首时，not only所在的分句需要部分倒装。②原句he protected the temple是一般过去时，倒装需要用助动词did提到主语he前面。③protect用动词原形（did后接原形）。④but also后面的分句不倒装。因此填did he protect。解题技巧：Not only在句首，找原句的时态（过去时→did，现在时→do/does，有be/情态动词直接提前），助动词提前后动词还原为原形。
examples.answer: did he protect。Not only置于句首引起部分倒装，用助动词did。

examples.title: 非限制性定语从句（中档题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The Great Wall, ______ is one of the world's most famous cultural heritage sites, attracts millions of tourists every year. A. that B. which C. what D. who
examples.analysis: 本题考查非限制性定语从句中关系代词的选择。分析步骤：①The Great Wall与后面的定语从句之间有逗号隔开，说明是非限制性定语从句。②先行词The Great Wall指物。③非限制性定语从句中不能用that，指物用which。④what不能引导定语从句；who指人不指物。因此选B. which。解题技巧：有逗号隔开的非限制性定语从句，不用that，指物用which，指人用who/whom。这是高频考点。
examples.answer: B. which。非限制性定语从句中不能用that，指物用which。

examples.title: worthwhile/worth/worthy辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The museum is really worth ______, and it is also worthwhile ______ there again. A. visiting; to go B. to visit; going C. visiting; going D. to visit; to go
examples.analysis: 本题考查worth, worthwhile的用法区别。分析两个空格：①worth后接动名词或名词（主动形式表被动意义），be worth doing = 值得做。因此第一空用visiting：The museum is worth visiting. ②worthwhile后可接to do或doing，be worthwhile to do/doing = 值得做。因此第二空用to go或going都可以。综合选项，A选项（visiting; to go）符合。解题技巧：worth后只能接动名词或名词（be worth doing/n.）；worthwhile后接to do或doing均可（It is worthwhile to do/doing）；worthy后接of being done或to be done（be worthy of being done = be worthy to be done）。
examples.answer: A. visiting; to go。worth后接动名词；worthwhile后可接to do。

examples.title: contribute to用法（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：Eating too much junk food contributes to ______ (gain) weight, so you'd better cut it out.
examples.analysis: 本题考查contribute to中to的词性判断及动名词用法。分析步骤：①contribute to意为"导致/有助于"，此处的to是介词而非不定式符号。②介词后接动词时需要用动名词形式。③因此空格处填gaining。解题技巧：contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。这与look forward to, be used to, be addicted to, devote...to等短语的用法一致。这类"to + 动名词"结构是高考高频考点，需要牢记。
examples.answer: gaining。contribute to中to为介词，后接动名词。

past_exams.question: Not only ______ ______ (he/protect) the temple, but he also raised funds for it.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查Not only置于句首的部分倒装。Not only在句首时，其所在分句需要部分倒装。原句he protected是一般过去时，倒装用助动词did提到主语前，protect用原形。but also后面的分句不倒装。
past_exams.answer: did he protect。Not only置于句首引起部分倒装，用助动词did。

past_exams.question:
The Great Wall, ______ is one of the world's most famous cultural heritage sites, attracts millions of tourists every year.
A. that  B. which  C. what  D. who
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查非限制性定语从句。The Great Wall后有逗号隔开，是非限制性定语从句。非限制性定语从句不能用that，指物用which。
past_exams.answer: B. which。非限制性定语从句中不能用that，指物用which。

past_exams.question: Eating too much junk food contributes to ______ (gain) weight, so you'd better cut it out.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查contribute to中to的词性。contribute to意为"导致/有助于"，to是介词而非不定式符号，后接名词或动名词。
past_exams.answer: gaining。contribute to中to为介词，后接动名词。

past_exams.question:
The museum is really worth ______, and it is also worthwhile ______ there again.
A. visiting; to go  B. to visit; going  C. visiting; going  D. to visit; to go
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查worth和worthwhile的用法。worth后接动名词（be worth doing），worthwhile后可接to do或doing。第一空用visiting，第二空用to go或going均可。
past_exams.answer: A. visiting; to go。worth后接动名词；worthwhile后可接to do。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：The ancient temple, ______ dates back to the Tang Dynasty, was carefully preserved. The local committee decided to take it ______ piece by piece and rebuild it on higher ground to protect it from the rising waters.
A. that; apart  B. which; apart  C. which; out  D. that; out
past_exams.analysis: 第一空：逗号后非限制性定语从句，不能用that，指物用which。第二空："拆开"用take apart。
past_exams.answer: B. which; apart。非限制性定语从句用which；take apart拆开。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The Aswan Dam project was one of the greatest cultural heritage rescue operations in history. When the Egyptian government decided to build the dam, it would flood many ancient temples. With the help of the international community, several temples were taken apart and rebuilt on higher ground. This project showed that cultural heritage protection requires global cooperation.
What made the Aswan Dam project significant?
A. It was the largest dam in the world.
B. It demonstrated global cooperation in heritage protection.
C. It was built by the Egyptian government alone.
D. It flooded all the ancient temples.
past_exams.analysis: 文章最后一句指出"This project showed that cultural heritage protection requires global cooperation"，说明该项目的重要性在于展示了遗产保护需要全球合作。
past_exams.answer: B。文章指出该项目展示了文化遗产保护需要全球合作。

past_exams.question:
He passed the exam, ______ made his parents very happy.
A. that  B. which  C. what  D. it
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查which指代整个主句的用法。逗号后的非限制性定语从句中，which指代前面整个主句"He passed the exam"这件事。不能用that，what不引导定语从句。
past_exams.answer: B. which。which指代整个主句，非限制性定语从句不能用that。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to protect cultural heritage?
___1___ Raise public awareness about the importance of cultural heritage through education.
___2___ Governments should establish laws and regulations to protect heritage sites.
___3___ International cooperation is essential, as many heritage issues cross national borders.
A. Educate the public.  B. Enforce laws.  C. Cooperate internationally.  D. Build more museums.  E. Sell artifacts.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"通过教育提高公众意识"，对应A。第二段讲"政府建立法律法规"，对应B。第三段讲"国际合作"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调教育公众、执法保护和国际合作。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Cultural heritage is not just about old buildings and artifacts. It includes intangible heritage such as languages, music, and traditions. However, many intangible heritage forms are disappearing. Experts argue that preserving intangible heritage is even more challenging than preserving physical monuments, because it relies on living people to pass it down.
Why is intangible heritage harder to preserve than physical monuments?
A. It is less valuable than physical monuments.
B. It depends on living people to transmit it.
C. It costs more money to preserve.
D. It cannot be documented at all.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出非物质文化遗产保护更具挑战性，因为它"relies on living people to pass it down"（依赖活人来传承）。
past_exams.answer: B。非物质文化遗产依赖活人传承，因此更难保存。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语社团正在开展"保护文化遗产"主题活动。请你写一封倡议书，呼吁同学们参与文化遗产保护。
范文：
Dear fellow students,
Cultural heritage is the treasure of our nation. However, many heritage sites are facing damage and destruction. It is high time that we took action to protect them.
First, we should raise awareness of cultural heritage protection among our classmates. Second, we can organize volunteer activities to clean and maintain local heritage sites. Third, let's spread the knowledge of cultural heritage through social media.
Not only does cultural heritage belong to the past, but it also belongs to the future. Let's join hands to protect our cultural heritage!
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查倡议书写作。①格式正确（称呼、正文、结尾、落款）；②结构清晰（引言→具体倡议→呼吁）；③使用高级句式（It is high time that..., Not only倒装）；④语气有号召力。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：格式正确、倡议具体、句式多样、有号召力。

chapters.title: Unit 2 Wildlife Protection 野生动植物保护
chapters.summary: 话题：野生动植物保护。语法：现在进行时的被动语态。写作：保护动物短文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: wildlife 野生动物（不可数名词）；species 物种（单复数同形，one species, two species）；endangered 濒危的（endangered species 濒危物种）；habitat 栖息地；reserve 保护区（nature reserve 自然保护区）；adapt 适应（adapt to 适应；adaptation n. 适应）；exist 存在（existence n. 存在）；attack 攻击；recover 恢复（recovery n. 恢复）；concern 担忧/关心（be concerned about 关心；concerning prep. 关于）；harmony 和谐（live in harmony with 与……和谐相处）。词汇辨析：adapt适应/改编；adopt收养/采纳。reserve保护区/储备/预订；preserve保护/保存；conserve节约/保护。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: die out 灭绝/消亡（不及物，无被动）；be concerned about 关心/担忧（= care about）；adapt to 适应（to是介词，后接名词或动名词）；under pressure 在压力下；be aware of 意识到（awareness n. 意识）；on average 平均；make progress 取得进步（progress不可数，不用a progress）。易错提示：die out/die off/die from/die of的区别——die out指物种灭绝或习俗消亡；die off指相继死去；die of指死于内因（疾病、饥饿）；die from指死于外因（事故、受伤）。adapt to中to是介词，后接动名词。make progress中progress是不可数名词，不能用a。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①...is being done（现在进行时的被动语态）。例：The forest is being destroyed by illegal logging. 森林正被非法砍伐破坏。②It is high time that sb. did sth. 是某人做某事的时候了（虚拟语气，从句用过去时）。例：It is high time that we took action to protect wildlife. 是我们采取行动保护野生动物的时候了。③Only by doing... can we... 只有通过做……我们才能……（Only+状语前置引起部分倒装）。例：Only by working together can we save these endangered species. 只有齐心协力，我们才能拯救这些濒危物种。

knowledge.title: 语法：现在进行时被动语态
knowledge.content: 现在进行时的被动语态结构：am/is/are + being + 过去分词。表示此刻或现阶段正在被进行的动作。例：The bridge is being built now. 桥梁正在被建造。The animals are being protected by the reserve. 动物正受到保护区的保护。变否定：am/is/are + not + being + done。变疑问：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + being + done? 注意事项：①being不可遗漏，这是与一般现在时被动（am/is/are done）和现在完成时被动（has/have been done）的关键区别。②某些表示状态而非动作的动词不用进行时被动（如have, own, belong to, know等不用进行时）。③现在进行时被动强调动作正在进行中，一般现在时被动强调习惯性或状态。学习提示：做题时先看时间状语判断时态，再看主语与动词关系判断语态。

exam_points.title: 现在进行时被动
exam_points.content: 现在进行时的被动语态是高考语法填空高频考点。解题技巧：①判断时态——看时间状语（now, at present, at the moment, look, listen等）确定是进行时。②判断语态——看主语与动词的关系（主语是动作承受者用被动）。③结构：am/is/are + being + 过去分词。④与一般现在时被动（am/is/are + done）的区别：进行时被动强调正在被做，一般现在时被动强调习惯/状态。⑤与现在完成时被动（has/have been done）的区别：进行时被动强调正在做，完成时被动强调已完成。高频易错：being不可遗漏。例：The problem is being discussed now.（不能漏掉being）。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①adapt/adopt辨析：adapt意为"适应/改编"（adapt to the environment 适应环境）；adopt意为"收养/采纳"（adopt a child 收养孩子；adopt a policy 采纳政策）。记忆口诀：a-d-a-p-t 适应（p像人弯腰适应）；a-d-o-p-t 收养（o像婴儿）。②die out/die of/die from/die off：die out 物种灭绝/习俗消亡（不及物）；die of 死于内因（疾病、饥饿、悲伤）；die from 死于外因（事故、受伤、污染）；die off 相继死去。③reserve/preserve/conserve：reserve 指保留/储备/保护区；preserve 指保持原样/保护；conserve 指节约使用/保护。

exam_points.title: 倒装
exam_points.content: Only + 状语（副词、介词短语、状语从句）置于句首时，主句使用部分倒装。解题技巧：①Only + 副词（then, later等）：Only then did I realize my mistake. ②Only + 介词短语：Only by working hard can we succeed. ③Only + 状语从句：Only when you lose your health will you realize its value. ④注意：Only + 主语不倒装（Only you can help me.）。⑤倒装方式：将助动词/be/情态动词提到主语前，没有助动词加do/does/did。学习提示：Only修饰状语且在句首才倒装，修饰主语不倒装。

examples.title: 被动语态（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：The old church ______ ______ ______ (repair) at present.
examples.analysis: 本题考查现在进行时的被动语态。分析步骤：①时间状语at present（目前）提示现在进行时。②主语the old church与repair之间是被动关系（教堂被修缮）。③现在进行时被动结构：am/is/are + being + 过去分词。④主语church是单数，用is。⑤repair的过去分词是repaired（加d）。因此填is being repaired。解题技巧：看到at present/now等时间状语且主语被做→现在进行时被动→am/is/are + being + done。
examples.answer: is being repaired。at present提示现在进行，主语被修用被动。

examples.title: 倒装句（中档题）
examples.question: 改写：Only by working together ______ ______ (we/save) these animals.
examples.analysis: 本题考查Only + 介词短语前置引起的部分倒装。分析步骤：①Only + by working together（介词短语作方式状语）置于句首，主句需要部分倒装。②原句we can save these animals有情态动词can，倒装时将can提到主语we前面。③因此填can we save。④注意：but also后面的分句不倒装。解题技巧：Only + 状语（副词/介词短语/状语从句）在句首→部分倒装→将be/助/情态动词提到主语前。
examples.answer: can we save。Only+状语前置引起部分倒装。

examples.title: adapt/adopt辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：After moving to the north, the family had to ______ to the cold climate, and they also ______ a stray dog. A. adapt; adopted B. adopt; adapted C. adapt; adapted D. adopt; adopted
examples.analysis: 本题考查adapt和adopt的辨析。分析两个空格：①第一空语境"搬到北方后，不得不______寒冷的气候"，表示"适应"气候，用adapt to。②第二空语境"他们还______了一只流浪狗"，表示"收养"狗，用adopt。因此选A. adapt; adopted。解题技巧：adapt = 适应/改编（adapt to + 环境）；adopt = 收养/采纳（adopt a child/policy）。这两个词拼写只差一个字母，但意思完全不同，是高考高频辨析词。
examples.answer: A. adapt; adopted。adapt to 适应；adopt 收养。

examples.title: die短语辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：Many rare species are ______ because of habitat loss and illegal hunting. A. dying out B. dying of C. dying from D. dying off
examples.analysis: 本题考查die相关短语的辨析。分析语境：主语Many rare species（许多稀有物种），谓语表示物种"灭绝/消亡"。四个选项：dying out指物种灭绝或习俗消亡，符合语境；dying of指死于内因（疾病、饥饿），主语通常是人不指物种；dying from指死于外因，也不用于物种灭绝；dying off指相继死去，强调一个接一个死，不强调灭绝。因此选A. dying out。解题技巧：物种灭绝用die out；死于疾病/饥饿用die of；死于事故/外伤用die from；相继死亡用die off。
examples.answer: A. dying out。die out指物种灭绝，符合rare species的语境。

past_exams.question: The old church ______ ______ ______ (repair) at present.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查现在进行时的被动语态。时间状语at present提示现在进行时，主语church与repair是被动关系。结构：is/are + being + 过去分词。
past_exams.answer: is being repaired。at present提示现在进行，主语被修用被动。

past_exams.question: Only by working together ______ ______ (we/save) these animals.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查Only+介词短语前置引起的部分倒装。Only + by working together置于句首，主句部分倒装，将情态动词can提到主语we前。
past_exams.answer: can we save。Only+状语前置引起部分倒装。

past_exams.question:
Many rare species are ______ because of habitat loss and illegal hunting.
A. dying out  B. dying of  C. dying from  D. dying off
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查die短语辨析。主语rare species（稀有物种），表示物种灭绝用die out。die of死于内因，die from死于外因，die off相继死去。
past_exams.answer: A. dying out。die out指物种灭绝，符合rare species的语境。

past_exams.question:
After moving to the north, the family had to ______ to the cold climate, and they also ______ a stray dog.
A. adapt; adopted  B. adopt; adapted  C. adapt; adapted  D. adopt; adopted
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"适应寒冷气候"用adapt to。第二空"收养流浪狗"用adopt。adapt=适应，adopt=收养。
past_exams.answer: A. adapt; adopted。adapt to适应；adopt收养。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：The nature reserve was established to protect endangered wildlife. At present, many rare animals ______ ______ ______ (protect) by the reserve staff. The number of Tibetan antelopes has been increasing steadily.
A. are protecting  B. are being protected  C. are protected  D. have protected
past_exams.analysis: 时间状语At present提示现在进行时，animals与protect是被动关系（动物被保护），用现在进行时被动语态are being protected。
past_exams.answer: B. are being protected。at present提示进行时，动物被保护用被动。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The giant panda was once on the verge of extinction. Thanks to decades of conservation efforts, the panda population has recovered significantly. In 2016, the IUCN changed the panda's status from 'endangered' to 'vulnerable.' This success story shows that with determination and resources, we can save endangered species.
What caused the change in the panda's conservation status?
A. The panda population decreased.
B. Decades of conservation efforts led to population recovery.
C. The IUCN stopped monitoring pandas.
D. Pandas learned to adapt to new habitats.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出"Thanks to decades of conservation efforts, the panda population has recovered significantly"，正是由于数十年的保护努力使种群数量恢复，IUCN才将大熊猫从"濒危"降为"易危"。
past_exams.answer: B。数十年的保护努力使大熊猫种群恢复，保护级别因此调整。

past_exams.question: It is high time that we ______ (take) action to protect wildlife.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查It is high time that...虚拟语气。该句型中从句谓语用一般过去时，表示"是做某事的时候了"。take的过去式是took。
past_exams.answer: took。It is high time that后从句用一般过去时（虚拟语气）。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to protect endangered species?
___1___ Habitat loss is the biggest threat to wildlife. We must protect natural habitats from destruction.
___2___ Laws against poaching and illegal wildlife trade must be strictly enforced.
___3___ Educating communities about the importance of biodiversity helps gain public support.
A. Protect habitats.  B. Enforce anti-poaching laws.  C. Educate the public.  D. Build more zoos.  E. Ignore the problem.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"栖息地丧失是最大威胁，必须保护栖息地"，对应A。第二段讲"严格执行反偷猎法律"，对应B。第三段讲"教育社区"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调保护栖息地、执法反偷猎和公众教育。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The concept of 'rewilding' has gained attention in recent years. Rewilding involves returning species to their natural habitats and allowing ecosystems to restore themselves naturally. Some experts believe this approach is more sustainable than traditional conservation methods. However, critics argue that rewilding may have unintended consequences, such as disrupting existing ecological balances.
What is the author's attitude towards rewilding?
A. Completely supportive.  B. Entirely negative.  C. Presenting both sides objectively.  D. Uninterested.
past_exams.analysis: 作者既介绍了rewilding的优点（更可持续），也指出了批评者的担忧（可能破坏生态平衡），态度客观中立。
past_exams.answer: C。作者客观呈现了rewilding的正反两方面观点。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"保护野生动植物"的短文。请你写一篇文章，介绍野生动植物保护的现状和你的建议。
范文：
Protecting Wildlife
Wildlife is an essential part of our planet's ecosystem. However, many species are currently being threatened by habitat loss, illegal hunting, and pollution.
Only by working together can we save these endangered species. First, the government should establish more nature reserves and enforce laws against poaching. Second, we should raise public awareness about the importance of wildlife protection. Third, as students, we can reduce waste and recycle to minimize environmental damage.
It is high time that we took action. Every species matters, and every effort counts. Let's work together to protect our wildlife for future generations.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查保护动物短文写作。①使用核心语法（现在进行时被动are being threatened，倒装Only by...can we，虚拟It is high time that...）；②结构清晰（现状→建议→呼吁）；③语言有力。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：语法结构多样、内容充实、呼吁有力。

chapters.title: Unit 3 The Internet 互联网
chapters.summary: 话题：互联网与生活。语法：现在完成时的被动语态。写作：网络利弊议论文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: convenient 方便的（be convenient for sb. 对某人方便；convenience n. 方便）；benefit 利益/受益（benefit from 从……受益；benefit sb. 使某人受益；beneficial adj. 有益的）；privacy 隐私（private adj. 私人的）；identity 身份（identity card 身份证）；update 更新；confirm 确认（confirm sth. with sb. 与某人确认某事）；distance 距离（in the distance 在远处；distant adj. 遥远的）；addicted 上瘾的（be addicted to 沉迷于）；battery 电池；discount 折扣（at a discount 打折）。词汇辨析：convenient不能以人作主语（不能说I am convenient，应说It is convenient for me）。benefit作动词时，benefit sb.（使某人受益）；benefit from sth.（从某事受益）。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: keep track of 跟踪/记录（keep track of expenses 记录开支）；keep sb. company 陪伴某人；now that 既然（= since，引导原因状语从句）；have access to 有权使用/可以使用（access n. 接触/使用机会）；in shape 状况良好/保持体型（keep in shape 保持体型）；belong to 属于（不用被动语态，不用进行时）。易错提示：belong to不能用被动语态和进行时（不能说is belonged to或is belonging to）。now that引导原因状语从句，that可省略。have access to中to是介词，后接名词。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①...has/have been done（现在完成时的被动语态）。例：The work has been finished. 工作已完成。②It is the first time that...has/have done 这是第一次做……。例：It is the first time that I have used this app. 这是我第一次用这个应用。注意：It is the first time后用现在完成时；It was the first time后用过去完成时。③so...that... 如此……以至于……。例：The Internet is so convenient that we can hardly live without it. 互联网如此方便，以至于我们几乎离不开它。

knowledge.title: 语法：现在完成时被动语态
knowledge.content: 现在完成时的被动语态结构：has/have + been + 过去分词。表示过去已完成且对现在有影响的被动动作，或过去开始持续到现在的被动状态。例：The work has been finished.（工作已完成，强调结果对现在的影响）。The bridge has been built.（桥已建好）。变否定：has/have + not + been + done。变疑问：Has/Have + 主语 + been + done? 与一般过去时被动的区别：一般过去时被动（was/were done）只强调过去被做，不强调对现在的影响；现在完成时被动强调对现在的影响或结果。例：The letter was written yesterday.（信昨天被写，强调过去时间）；The letter has been written.（信已被写好，强调现在已写完的结果）。时间状语搭配：现在完成时被动常与already, yet, just, so far, up to now, recently, since, for等连用。学习提示：判断用现在完成时被动还是一般过去时被动的关键——看是否强调对现在的影响以及时间状语。

exam_points.title: 现在完成时被动
exam_points.content: 现在完成时的被动语态是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①判断时态——看时间状语（so far, up to now, already, yet, just, recently, since, for + 时间段）确定现在完成时。②判断语态——主语是动作承受者用被动。③结构：has/have + been + 过去分词。④been不可遗漏（与一般过去时被动was/were done区别）。⑤与一般过去时被动的区别：现在完成时被动强调对现在的影响或从过去持续到现在；一般过去时被动只强调过去发生的动作。例：The room has been cleaned.（已打扫，现在干净了）；The room was cleaned yesterday.（昨天打扫了，不强调现在状态）。高频易错：been不可遗漏。

exam_points.title: 议论文写作
