exam_points.content: 网络利弊是高考写作热门话题。写作要点：①结构：引出话题（互联网的普及）→分析利（方便、信息丰富、沟通便捷）→分析弊（沉迷、隐私泄露、虚假信息）→结论（合理使用）。②连接词：on one hand...on the other hand一方面……另一方面；however然而；in addition此外；what's more而且；as a result结果；in conclusion总之。③常用表达：bring convenience带来方便；have access to information获取信息；communicate with与……交流；be addicted to沉迷于；waste time浪费时间；protect privacy保护隐私。④观点表达：Personally, I think...; In my opinion...; From my point of view...。学习提示：议论文要观点明确，论据充分，正反对比，逻辑清晰。

exam_points.title: 词汇辨析
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①benefit from/by：benefit from sth.（从某事中受益）；sth. benefits sb.（某事使某人受益）；be beneficial to sb.（对某人有益）。②convenient不能用 "人" 作主语。错误：I am convenient to go there. 正确：It is convenient for me to go there. / If it is convenient for you. ③belong to不用被动和进行时。错误：The book is belonged to me. 正确：The book belongs to me. 解题技巧：convenient的常见句型——It is convenient for sb. to do sth. / sth. is convenient for sb.。benefit的两种用法——A benefits B（A使B受益）= B benefits from A（B从A受益）。

examples.title: 被动语态（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：All the tickets ______ ______ ______ (sell) online so far.
examples.analysis: 本题考查现在完成时的被动语态。分析步骤：①时间状语so far（到目前为止）提示现在完成时。②主语All the tickets与sell之间是被动关系（票被售出）。③现在完成时被动结构：has/have + been + 过去分词。④主语tickets是复数，用have。⑤sell的过去分词是sold。因此填have been sold。解题技巧：so far是现在完成时标志词，看到so far就要想到has/have + done，再看主被动关系。
examples.answer: have been sold。so far提示现在完成，tickets被售用被动。

examples.title: 时态句型翻译（中档题）
examples.question: 翻译：这是我第一次参观故宫。
examples.analysis: 本题考查It is the first time that...句型及现在完成时。分析步骤：①"这是我第一次做……"用固定句型It is the first time that sb. has/have done sth.。②that从句中需要用现在完成时。③"参观故宫"用visit the Palace Museum。④主语I用have。完整句子：It is the first time that I have visited the Palace Museum. 注意：如果主句是过去时It was the first time，从句用过去完成时had done。解题技巧：It is the first time that + 现在完成时；It was the first time that + 过去完成时。
examples.answer: It is the first time that I have visited the Palace Museum.

examples.title: convenient用法（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：— When shall we meet? — ______ is convenient for you. A. I am B. It is C. You are D. That is
examples.analysis: 本题考查convenient的用法限制。分析要点：convenient不能用"人"作主语（不能说I am convenient或You are convenient）。正确的表达是It is convenient for sb. 或某事/某时间is convenient for sb.。选项B "It is"符合用法，It作形式主语。选项A "I am"、选项C "You are"都以人作主语，语法错误。选项D "That is"语义不通。因此选B。解题技巧：convenient的主语通常是it或事物/时间，不能用"人"。类似用法的词还有necessary, important等（It is necessary/important for sb. to do sth.）。
examples.answer: B. It is。convenient不能以人作主语，用It is convenient for sb.。

examples.title: belong to用法（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：The book ______ (belong) to the library must be returned before Friday.
examples.analysis: 本题考查belong to的用法及其非谓语形式。分析步骤：①主句结构是The book must be returned before Friday（书必须在周五前归还）。②______ to the library是定语，修饰The book。③belong to（属于）不用被动语态和进行时，因此不能说belonged to（过去分词表被动，不当）或belonging to的进行时形式。但这里belong to作定语修饰book，book和belong to之间是主动关系（book belongs to library），用现在分词belonging to作后置定语。因此填belonging。解题技巧：belong to虽然不用被动和进行时态，但可以以其现在分词形式belonging to作定语或状语，表示主动关系。
examples.answer: belonging。belong to与book是主动关系，用现在分词作定语。

past_exams.question: All the tickets ______ ______ ______ (sell) online so far.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查现在完成时的被动语态。时间状语so far提示现在完成时，tickets与sell是被动关系（票被售出）。结构：have + been + 过去分词。
past_exams.answer: have been sold。so far提示现在完成时，票被售用被动。

past_exams.question: The book ______ (belong) to the library must be returned before Friday.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查belong to的现在分词作定语。belong to不用被动和进行时态，但可以用现在分词belonging to作定语表示主动关系（book belongs to library）。
past_exams.answer: belonging。belong to与book是主动关系，用现在分词作定语。

past_exams.question:
— When shall we meet? — ______ is convenient for you.
A. I am  B. It is  C. You are  D. That is
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查convenient的用法。convenient不能以人作主语，用It is convenient for sb.的句型。
past_exams.answer: B. It is。convenient不能以人作主语，用It is convenient for sb.。

past_exams.question: This is the first time that I ______ (use) this app.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查It is the first time that...句型。该句型中that从句用现在完成时。主语I用have。
past_exams.answer: have used。It is the first time that后用现在完成时。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：The Internet has changed our lives dramatically. It is so ______ that we can hardly live without it. However, we should also be aware of its ______, such as privacy risks and internet addiction.
A. convenient; benefits  B. convenient; risks  C. convenience; risks  D. convenience; benefits
past_exams.analysis: 第一空作表语用形容词convenient。第二空根据privacy risks和internet addiction可知是"风险/弊端"，用risks。
past_exams.answer: B. convenient; risks。convenient作形容词表语；risks指弊端/风险。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Social media has revolutionized how we communicate, but it has also created new challenges. Studies show that excessive social media use can lead to anxiety and depression, especially among teenagers. Moreover, the spread of misinformation on social media has become a serious concern. Experts suggest setting time limits and verifying information before sharing.
What does the passage suggest about social media?
A. It is entirely harmful and should be banned.
B. It has both benefits and drawbacks that need to be managed.
C. It only causes mental health problems.
D. It is completely safe if used properly.
past_exams.analysis: 文章既提到社交媒体改变了沟通方式（积极面），也指出了焦虑、抑郁、虚假信息等问题（消极面），并建议设置时间限制和核实信息。说明社交媒体有利有弊，需要合理管理。
past_exams.answer: B。文章指出社交媒体既有好处也有弊端，需要合理管理。

past_exams.question: The Internet is so convenient ______ we can hardly live without it.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查so...that...句型（如此……以至于……）。so修饰convenient，that引导结果状语从句。
past_exams.answer: that。so...that...如此……以至于……，that引导结果状语从句。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to stay safe online?
___1___ Never share personal information such as your address or phone number on public platforms.
___2___ Use strong passwords and change them regularly to protect your accounts.
___3___ Be cautious of suspicious links and emails that may contain viruses.
A. Protect personal information.  B. Use strong passwords.  C. Avoid suspicious links.  D. Share everything online.  E. Use the same password everywhere.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"不要分享个人信息"，对应A。第二段讲"使用强密码"，对应B。第三段讲"警惕可疑链接"，对应C。D和E与网络安全建议相反。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调保护隐私、使用强密码和警惕可疑链接。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The digital divide refers to the gap between those who have access to modern information technology and those who do not. In rural areas of many developing countries, internet access remains limited. This inequality affects education, employment opportunities, and access to essential services. Addressing the digital divide has become a priority for many governments and international organizations.
What is the main idea of the passage?
A. The Internet is too expensive for most people.
B. The digital divide creates inequality in access to technology and opportunities.
C. Rural areas should move to cities for better internet.
D. Developing countries cannot afford any technology.
past_exams.analysis: 文章核心讨论"数字鸿沟"（digital divide）及其造成的不平等，影响教育、就业和基本服务获取。选B。
past_exams.answer: B。文章主旨是数字鸿沟造成了技术和机会获取的不平等。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"互联网的利与弊"的议论文。请你写一篇文章，分析互联网的利弊并给出你的看法。
范文：
The Internet: A Double-Edged Sword
The Internet has become an indispensable part of our lives. On one hand, it brings great convenience. We have access to a vast amount of information and can communicate with people worldwide. Online education has made learning more flexible than ever.
On the other hand, the Internet also has drawbacks. Many teenagers are addicted to social media, which affects their studies and health. Moreover, privacy issues and the spread of false information have become serious problems.
In my opinion, the Internet itself is neither good nor bad. It is up to us to use it wisely. Only by using it responsibly can we benefit from it while avoiding its harms.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查网络利弊议论文。①结构清晰（利→弊→个人观点）；②连接词使用得当；③高级句式（Only by...can we倒装）；④观点辩证客观。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：结构完整、论证充分、句式多样、观点明确。

chapters.title: Unit 4 History and Traditions 历史与传统
chapters.summary: 话题：英国历史与传统文化。语法：过去分词作定语和宾补。写作：地点/景点介绍。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: ancestor 祖先；philosopher 哲学家（philosophy 哲学）；individual 个人/个人的；belong 属于（belong to 属于）；evidence 证据（evident adj. 明显的）；achieve 达到/实现（achievement n. 成就）；generous 慷慨的（be generous to sb. 对某人慷慨；be generous with sth. 在某方面慷慨）；position 位置/职位（in position 在正确位置）；fascinating 迷人的（fascinate v. 使着迷；fascinated adj. 被迷住的）；landscape 风景/地貌。词汇辨析：achieve强调通过努力实现目标；reach强调到达某处或水平；attain较正式，指达到高水平。evidence指证据；proof指确凿的证据。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: belong to 属于（不用被动和进行时）；as well as 也/和（连接平行结构，谓语动词与前面的主语一致）；be proud of 以……为豪（= take pride in）；break away from 脱离/挣脱；result in 导致/造成（= lead to；result from 由……造成）；leave behind 留下/遗留。易错提示：as well as连接两个主语时，谓语动词与前面的主语保持一致（He as well as I is interested in English. 用is不用are）。result in后接结果；result from后接原因。break away from指脱离组织、关系等。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①过去分词短语作后置定语。例：The castle built in the 12th century is a tourist attraction. 建于12世纪的城堡是一个旅游景点。②have/get sth. done 使某事被做（让别人做或遭遇某事）。例：I had my hair cut yesterday. 我昨天理了发（让别人剪的）。He had his bike stolen. 他的自行车被偷了（遭遇不幸）。③with + 宾语 + 过去分词（宾补，表被动或完成）。例：With the work finished, he went home. 工作完成后，他回家了。With his eyes fixed on the screen, he didn't notice me. 眼睛盯着屏幕，他没注意到我。

knowledge.title: 语法：过去分词作定语与宾补
knowledge.content: 过去分词作定语：①单个过去分词作定语通常前置。例：fallen leaves 落叶；broken glass 碎玻璃；a written report 书面报告。②过去分词短语作定语后置。例：The book written by him is popular. 他写的书很受欢迎。③及物动词的过去分词表被动和完成；不及物动词的过去分词只表完成不表被动。例：fallen leaves（fall是不及物动词，fallen只表"已落下"，不表被动）；the risen sun 升起的太阳。④现在分词与过去分词作定语的区别：现在分词表主动和进行（the boiling water 沸腾的水）；过去分词表被动和完成（the boiled water 开水/已煮开的水）。过去分词作宾补：①have/get sth. done 使某事被做（让别人做）。例：I had my car repaired. 我让人修了车。②表遭遇。例：He had his leg broken. 他摔断了腿。③表完成。例：I have had my homework done. 我已经把作业做完了。④与have sb. do（让某人做）和have sb. doing（让某人一直做）的区别：have sth. done强调某事被别人做；have sb. do强调让某人做某事（主动）；have sb. doing强调让某人一直做某事。学习提示：过去分词的核心意义是"被动"和"完成"，判断时看分词与所修饰词之间的关系——主动关系用现在分词，被动关系用过去分词。

exam_points.title: 过去分词作定语
exam_points.content: 过去分词作定语是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①判断分词与被修饰词的关系——主动关系用现在分词（-ing），被动关系用过去分词（-ed）。②判断时态——现在分词表进行，过去分词表完成。例：the surprising news 令人惊讶的消息（news发出surprise的动作，主动）；the surprised people 感到惊讶的人（人被惊讶，被动）。③单个分词前置，分词短语后置。④不及物动词的过去分词只表完成不表被动（fallen leaves落叶）。⑤有些过去分词已形容词化（如tired, interested, excited）。高频考点：boiling water（沸水）vs boiled water（开水）；developing country（发展中国家）vs developed country（发达国家）；falling leaves（正落的叶）vs fallen leaves（落叶）。

exam_points.title: 过去分词作宾补
exam_points.content: have/get sth. done结构是高考重点。解题技巧：①have sth. done的三种含义：a) 使某事被做（让别人做）——I had my hair cut. 我理了发（别人剪的）；b) 遭遇不幸——He had his wallet stolen. 钱包被偷了；c) 完成某事——I have had my work done. 我完成了工作。②与have sb. do（让某人做，主动）的区别：I had him repair the car. 我让他修车（他主动修）；I had the car repaired. 我让车被修了（车被修）。③与have sb. doing（让某人一直做）的区别：He had me waiting for two hours. 他让我等了两小时。④get sth. done = have sth. done。学习提示：关键是判断宾语与宾补的关系——宾语是宾补动作的承受者用过去分词（done），发出者用现在分词（doing）或省略to的不定式（do）。

exam_points.title: 地点介绍写作
exam_points.content: 地点/景点介绍是常见写作题型。写作要点：①结构：位置→历史→特色/景点→文化/传统→感受/建议。②常用表达：be located/situated in 位于；has a history of...years 有……年历史；be famous for 以……著名；be known as 作为……而闻名；date back to 追溯到；attract tourists 吸引游客；a must-see place 必去之地；rich in culture 文化丰富。③用分词丰富表达：The temple, built in the Tang Dynasty, attracts many visitors.（过去分词短语作定语）；Located in the south of China, the city has a mild climate.（过去分词作状语）。④时态：介绍历史用过去时，描述现状用现在时。学习提示：适当使用过去分词短语作定语和状语，可使文章句式多样、语言精炼。

examples.title: 过去分词作定语（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：The building ______ (build) in 1900 is still in use.
examples.analysis: 本题考查过去分词作后置定语。分析步骤：①The building后面需要一个定语修饰building。②判断build与building的关系——building被build（建筑被建造），是被动关系。③且建造动作已完成（in 1900），因此用过去分词built。④built in 1900作后置定语修饰building，相当于定语从句which was built in 1900的简化。解题技巧：判断用现在分词还是过去分词——看分词与被修饰词的关系，被动关系用过去分词（-ed），主动关系用现在分词（-ing）。
examples.answer: built。build与building为被动关系且已完成，用过去分词。

examples.title: 宾补结构翻译（中档题）
examples.question: 翻译：我昨天让人修了电脑。
examples.analysis: 本题考查have sth. done结构。分析步骤：①"让人修电脑"表示电脑被别人修（不是自己修），用have sth. done结构。②"电脑"是宾语，"修"的过去分词repaired是宾补。③"昨天"用yesterday，时态用一般过去时had。完整句子：I had the computer repaired yesterday. 注意：have sth. done强调让别人做某事，不是自己做。如果自己修则用I repaired the computer myself. 解题技巧："让人做某事"或"某物被做"用have/get sth. done，过去分词表被动。
examples.answer: I had the computer repaired yesterday.

examples.title: 分词辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The ______ look on her face suggested that she was ______ at the news. A. surprising; surprised B. surprised; surprising C. surprising; surprising D. surprised; surprised
examples.analysis: 本题考查现在分词与过去分词作形容词的辨析。分析两个空格：①第一空修饰look（表情），描述表情本身"令人惊讶的"，用现在分词surprising。但进一步分析："look on her face"指"她脸上的表情"，这是她自己的表情，她感到惊讶，所以应该用surprised look（惊讶的表情，指她感到惊讶时的表情）。②第二空修饰she（她），人感到惊讶，用surprised。但根据语境"suggested that she was ___ at the news"，她对这个消息感到惊讶，用surprised。重新分析：第一空"她脸上的表情"是惊讶的表情（她感到惊讶），用surprised look；第二空她感到惊讶用surprised。因此选D. surprised; surprised。解题技巧：-ing形容词描述事物本身的性质（令人……的），-ed形容词描述人的感受（感到……的）。但look（表情）可以用-ed修饰，表示"带有某种感受的表情"。
examples.answer: D. surprised; surprised。第一空surprised look表示她惊讶的表情；第二空she感到惊讶用surprised。

examples.title: with复合结构（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：With his eyes ______ (fix) on the screen, he didn't notice me come in.
examples.analysis: 本题考查with复合结构中宾补的形式。分析步骤：①with + 宾语(his eyes) + 宾补构成with复合结构，作伴随状语。②判断eyes与fix的关系——eyes被fix（眼睛被固定在屏幕上），是被动关系。③且表示状态，用过去分词fixed。因此填fixed。解题技巧：with + 宾语 + 宾补的宾补选择：主动关系用现在分词（With him helping me, I finished the work.）；被动关系用过去分词（With the work done, I went home.）；将来动作用不定式（With so much work to do, I can't go.）。
examples.answer: fixed。eyes与fix是被动关系，用过去分词作with的宾补。

past_exams.question: The building ______ (build) in 1900 is still in use.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查过去分词作后置定语。building与build是被动关系（建筑被建造），且已完成（in 1900），用过去分词built。
past_exams.answer: built。build与building为被动关系且已完成，用过去分词。

past_exams.question: I had my computer ______ (repair) yesterday.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查have sth. done结构。"让人修电脑"表示电脑被别人修（不是自己修），用过去分词repaired作宾补。
past_exams.answer: repaired。have sth. done表示使某事被做（让别人做）。

past_exams.question:
选择最佳答案：The ______ water is safe to drink, while the ______ water is still hot.
A. boiling; boiled  B. boiled; boiling  C. boiling; boiling  D. boiled; boiled
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查现在分词与过去分词作定语的区别。boiling water=正在沸腾的水（主动进行）；boiled water=已烧开的水（被动完成）。第一空"安全饮用"的是已烧开的水boiled water；第二空"仍然很热"的是正在沸腾的水boiling water。
past_exams.answer: B. boiled; boiling。boiled water已烧开的水；boiling water正在沸腾的水。

past_exams.question: With his eyes ______ (fix) on the screen, he didn't notice me come in.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查with复合结构中宾补的形式。eyes与fix是被动关系（眼睛被固定在屏幕上），用过去分词fixed。
past_exams.answer: fixed。eyes与fix是被动关系，用过去分词作with的宾补。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：The ancient castle, ______ in the 12th century, is one of the most popular tourist attractions in the region. The local government has had it ______ several times to preserve its original appearance.
A. built; restored  B. building; restored  C. built; restoring  D. building; restoring
past_exams.analysis: 第一空：castle与build是被动关系（城堡被建造），用过去分词built作后置定语。第二空：have sth. done结构，castle被修复，用restored。
past_exams.answer: A. built; restored。built过去分词作定语；have it restored使它被修复。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The United Kingdom consists of four nations: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Each has its own distinct culture and traditions. The UK's history is reflected in its architecture, from ancient Roman walls to medieval castles and modern skyscrapers. Visitors can explore centuries of history in a single trip.
What does the passage suggest about the UK?
A. It has a single unified culture with no regional differences.
B. It has diverse cultures and a rich architectural history.
C. It only has modern buildings.
D. It has no historical sites to visit.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出UK由四个国家组成，各有独特文化和传统，建筑反映了从古罗马到现代的历史。说明英国文化多元、建筑历史丰富。
past_exams.answer: B。文章指出英国文化多元，建筑历史丰富。

past_exams.question: He had his wallet ______ (steal) on the bus yesterday.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查have sth. done表遭遇不幸。wallet与steal是被动关系（钱包被偷），用过去分词stolen。
past_exams.answer: stolen。have sth. done表遭遇不幸，钱包被偷用过去分词。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：Visiting historical sites responsibly.
___1___ Follow the rules and do not touch or climb on ancient structures.
___2___ Hire a local guide to learn about the history and significance of the site.
___3___ Respect local customs and traditions when visiting historical sites.
A. Follow the rules.  B. Learn from a guide.  C. Respect local customs.  D. Take souvenirs home.  E. Ignore the signs.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"遵守规则，不要触摸古建筑"，对应A。第二段讲"请导游了解历史"，对应B。第三段讲"尊重当地习俗"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调遵守规则、请导游和尊重习俗。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The preservation of historical buildings often involves a debate between development and conservation. While some argue that old buildings should be replaced with modern structures for economic growth, others believe that historical architecture is irreplaceable cultural heritage. The challenge lies in finding a balance between progress and preservation.
What is the main debate discussed in the passage?
A. Whether to build more skyscrapers.
B. Whether to prioritize development or conservation of historical buildings.
C. Whether historical buildings are safe to live in.
D. Whether modern architecture is better than historical architecture.
past_exams.analysis: 文章讨论了历史建筑保护中"发展与保护"的争论——有人主张用现代建筑替代旧建筑以促进经济增长，有人认为历史建筑是不可替代的文化遗产。
past_exams.answer: B。文章讨论的是历史建筑保护中发展与保护之间的争论。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你的英国笔友Tom计划来中国旅游，想了解一处中国历史文化景点。请你写一封邮件，向他介绍故宫。
范文：
Dear Tom,
I'm glad to hear that you're planning to visit China. I highly recommend the Forbidden City, located in the center of Beijing.
Built in the 15th century, it served as the imperial palace for over 500 years. With a history of more than 600 years, it is one of the best-preserved ancient wooden structures in the world. The palace, surrounded by a massive red wall, contains thousands of rooms and countless historical artifacts.
When visiting, you can explore the magnificent halls and learn about Chinese imperial history. It is definitely a must-see place.
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查地点/景点介绍。①使用过去分词短语（Built in..., surrounded by...）丰富表达；②结构清晰（位置→历史→特色→建议）；③时态恰当（历史用过去时，现状用现在时）。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：分词结构使用、结构清晰、内容充实。

chapters.title: Unit 5 Music 音乐
chapters.summary: 话题：音乐与虚拟合唱团。语法：过去分词作状语。写作：音乐的影响短文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: perform 表演/执行（performance n. 表演；performer n. 表演者）；stage 舞台；award 奖项/授予（win an award 获奖）；composition 作品/作曲（compose v. 作曲）；capable 有能力的（be capable of doing sth. 能够做某事）；phenomenon 现象（复数phenomena）；treatment 治疗/对待（treat v. 对待/治疗）；relief 缓解/宽慰（to one's relief 令某人宽慰的是）；thus 因此（= therefore）；equipment 设备（不可数名词）。词汇辨析：award指正式颁发的奖项或奖品；reward指报答、酬金。capable强调有能力做某事（be capable of doing）；able强调有能力做某事（be able to do）。equipment是不可数名词，不能加s。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: fall in love with 爱上；be capable of 能够（后接动名词）；in addition to 除……之外（还有，to是介词，后接动名词）；take part in 参加（= participate in）；come up with 想出/提出（come up with an idea 想出主意）；from then on 从那时起。易错提示：in addition to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。be capable of后接动名词。come up with是固定短语，不能拆开。fall in love with强调瞬间动作（爱上）；be in love with强调状态（恋爱中）。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①过去分词作状语（可表时间、原因、条件、让步、方式等）。例：Given more time, I could do better. 如果多给点时间，我能做得更好。（条件）Tired out, he fell asleep quickly. 累坏了，他很快睡着了。（原因）②It is said that... 据说……。例：It is said that music can heal the soul. 据说音乐能治愈心灵。③Not only...but also... 不仅……而且……（置于句首倒装）。例：Not only does music bring joy, but it also helps people relax. 音乐不仅带来快乐，还帮助人们放松。

knowledge.title: 语法：过去分词作状语
knowledge.content: 过去分词作状语表示被动或完成的动作，其逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。用法分类：①时间状语：Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful. 从山上望下去，城市很美。（= When the city is seen from the hill）②原因状语：Moved by the music, she began to cry. 被音乐感动，她开始哭泣。（= Because she was moved by the music）③条件状语：Given another chance, I would do better. 如果再给一次机会，我会做得更好。（= If I were given another chance）④让步状语：Though tired, he kept working. 虽然累了，他仍继续工作。（= Though he was tired）⑤方式/伴随状语：He came in, followed by his dog. 他走了进来，后面跟着他的狗。注意事项：①过去分词与现在分词的区别：过去分词表被动（逻辑主语是动作承受者）；现在分词表主动（逻辑主语是动作发出者）。例：Seeing from the hill, I found the city beautiful.（I主动看，用seeing）；Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful.（city被看，用seen）。②分词的否定形式：not + 过去分词。例：Not given enough time, he couldn't finish the task. ③有些固定过去分词短语已演化为介词或连词，如given（考虑到）、provided（如果）、compared to/with（与……相比）。④be faced with, be dressed in, be seated等中过去分词已形容词化，可直接作状语：Faced with difficulties, she didn't give up.（不说Facing with difficulties）。学习提示：做分词状语题的关键是判断分词与主句主语的关系——主动用-ing，被动用-ed。

exam_points.title: 过去分词作状语
exam_points.content: 过去分词作状语是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①第一步：找主句主语——分词状语的逻辑主语就是主句主语。②第二步：判断分词与主语的关系——主动关系用现在分词（-ing），被动关系用过去分词（-ed）。③第三步：判断时态——同时发生用一般式（doing/done），先于主句动作完成用完成式（having done/having been done）。④否定形式：not + 分词（Not knowing... / Not given...）。⑤固定搭配：faced with（面临），dressed in（穿着），lost in（沉浸于），compared to/with（与……相比）等用过去分词。高频易错：be faced with的faced作状语不能用facing（Faced with difficulties, not Facing with difficulties）。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①perform/performance/performer：perform v. 表演/执行（perform a play 表演戏剧；perform an operation 做手术）；performance n. 表演/表现（give a performance 表演）；performer n. 表演者。②award/reward辨析：award指正式颁发的奖项或荣誉（win the first award 获一等奖；award sb. sth. 授予某人某物）；reward指报答、酬金、奖赏（in reward for 作为对……的奖赏；reward sb. for sth. 因某事奖赏某人）。③equipment是不可数名词，"一件设备"用a piece of equipment。解题技巧：award侧重"荣誉性奖项"，reward侧重"物质性酬谢"。

exam_points.title: 写作
exam_points.content: 用过去分词作状语可使句式多样，是写作加分项。写作要点：①用过去分词作状语替代状语从句，使语言简洁。例：Moved by the story, he decided to help.（替代Because he was moved by the story, he decided to help.）②用过去分词短语作定语丰富表达。例：The music composed by him is popular worldwide.（替代The music which was composed by him is popular worldwide.）③常用表达：bring joy 带来快乐；heal the soul 治愈心灵；express emotions 表达情感；relieve stress 缓解压力；inspire people 鼓舞人心；have a positive effect on 对……有积极影响。④常用句式：Not only does music..., but it also...；It is said that...；There is no doubt that...。学习提示：在写作中适当使用1-2个过去分词状语，可提升语言档次。

examples.title: 分词作状语（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：______ (give) another chance, he would succeed.
examples.analysis: 本题考查过去分词作条件状语。分析步骤：①主句主语是he。②判断give与he的关系——he是被给机会（如果他被给机会），是被动关系。③因此用过去分词Given。④Given another chance = If he were given another chance（条件状语从句的简化）。解题技巧：判断用现在分词还是过去分词——看分词与主句主语的关系，被动关系用过去分词（-ed），主动关系用现在分词（-ing）。
examples.answer: Given。give与he为被动关系，作条件状语用过去分词。

examples.title: 固定搭配分词（中档题）
examples.question: 填空：______ (face) with difficulties, she didn't give up.
examples.analysis: 本题考查be faced with固定搭配中过去分词作状语的用法。分析步骤：①face with是固定搭配（be faced with 面临），其中faced已经形容词化。②当faced with作状语时，直接用Faced with，不用Facing with。③Faced with difficulties = When she was faced with difficulties。因此填Faced。解题技巧：be faced with（面临）、be dressed in（穿着）、be lost in（沉浸于）、be seated（就座）等固定结构中的过去分词已形容词化，作状语时直接用过去分词形式，不用现在分词。这是高考高频易错点。
examples.answer: Faced。be faced with固定搭配，作状语用faced。

examples.title: award/reward辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The scientist was ______ the Nobel Prize for his great contribution to medicine, and he also received a large sum of money as a ______. A. awarded; reward B. rewarded; award C. awarded; award D. rewarded; reward
examples.analysis: 本题考查award和reward的辨析。分析两个空格：①第一空语境"科学家被授予诺贝尔奖"，award指正式颁发的奖项，用was awarded（被动语态）。②第二空语境"还得到了一大笔钱作为酬谢/奖赏"，reward指物质性酬谢或奖赏，用reward。因此选A. awarded; reward。解题技巧：award侧重"荣誉性奖项"（Nobel Prize, Oscar等），可作动词（award sb. sth. 授予某人某物）和名词（奖项）；reward侧重"物质性酬谢"（金钱、礼物等），可作动词（reward sb. for sth. 因某事奖赏某人）和名词（酬金）。
examples.answer: A. awarded; reward。award指颁发奖项；reward指物质酬谢。

examples.title: 分词时态（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：______ (finish) his homework, he went out to play football.
examples.analysis: 本题考查分词作状语的时态选择。分析步骤：①主句主语是he，finish与he是主动关系（他完成作业），考虑用现在分词。②但finish（完成作业）这个动作发生在went out（出去）之前，即先完成作业再出去。③表示先于主句动作完成的分词状语，用完成式having done。④因此填Having finished。⑤Having finished his homework = After he had finished his homework。解题技巧：如果分词动作与主句动作同时发生，用一般式doing；如果分词动作先于主句动作完成，用完成式having done。
examples.answer: Having finished。finish先于went out完成，用完成式having done。

past_exams.question: ______ (give) another chance, he would succeed.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查过去分词作条件状语。主句主语he与give是被动关系（他被给机会），用过去分词Given。Given another chance = If he were given another chance。
past_exams.answer: Given。give与he为被动关系，作条件状语用过去分词。

past_exams.question: ______ (face) with difficulties, she didn't give up.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查be faced with固定搭配。faced with已形容词化，作状语时直接用Faced with，不用Facing with。
past_exams.answer: Faced。be faced with固定搭配，作状语用faced。

past_exams.question:
The scientist was ______ the Nobel Prize for his great contribution, and he also received a large sum of money as a ______.
A. awarded; reward  B. rewarded; award  C. awarded; award  D. rewarded; reward
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"被授予诺贝尔奖"用award（指正式颁发的奖项）。第二空"一大笔钱作为酬谢"用reward（指物质性酬谢）。
past_exams.answer: A. awarded; reward。award指颁发奖项；reward指物质酬谢。

past_exams.question: ______ (finish) his homework, he went out to play football.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查分词作状语的时态。finish与he是主动关系，但finish先于went out完成，用完成式having done。
past_exams.answer: Having finished。finish先于went out完成，用完成式having done。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：Music has the power to heal. ______ (move) by the beautiful melody, the audience began to cry. The ______, composed by a young musician, was performed perfectly.
A. Moving; composition  B. Moved; composition  C. Moved; composer  D. Moving; composer
past_exams.analysis: 第一空：audience与move是被动关系（观众被感动），用过去分词Moved。第二空："作品"用composition（由作曲家创作）。
past_exams.answer: B. Moved; composition。audience被感动用过去分词；composition指作品。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Music therapy has been used to help patients with various conditions, from anxiety to chronic pain. Research shows that listening to music can lower blood pressure, reduce stress hormones, and boost the immune system. Some hospitals have even hired professional musicians to perform for patients, reporting significant improvements in recovery rates.
According to the passage, what is NOT a benefit of music therapy?
A. Lowering blood pressure.  B. Reducing stress hormones.  C. Curing all diseases completely.  D. Boosting the immune system.
past_exams.analysis: 文章提到了降低血压、减少压力荷尔蒙、增强免疫系统。选项C"完全治愈所有疾病"未提及且过于绝对。
past_exams.answer: C。文章未提到音乐治疗能完全治愈所有疾病。

past_exams.question: Not only ______ music bring joy, but it also helps people relax.（用倒装填空）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查Not only置于句首的部分倒装。Not only在句首，其所在分句倒装。原句music brings joy是一般现在时，倒装用助动词does提到主语music前，bring用原形。
past_exams.answer: does。Not only置于句首引起部分倒装，用助动词does。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How does music affect our lives?
___1___ Studies show that listening to calming music can reduce stress and anxiety.
___2___ Music can bring back memories and emotions associated with past experiences.
___3___ Learning to play an instrument can improve cognitive skills and creativity.
A. Music reduces stress.  B. Music triggers memories.  C. Music enhances cognition.  D. Music causes insomnia.  E. Music is expensive.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"舒缓的音乐减少压力"，对应A。第二段讲"音乐唤起记忆"，对应B。第三段讲"学习乐器提高认知"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调减压、唤起记忆和提高认知。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The virtual choir, pioneered by composer Eric Whitacre, allows singers from around the world to perform together without being in the same place. Each singer records their part and uploads it online, and the videos are combined into a single performance. Whitacre believes that the virtual choir demonstrates how technology can connect people through music, breaking down geographical barriers.
What is the main advantage of the virtual choir according to the passage?
A. It is cheaper than traditional choirs.
B. It connects singers globally regardless of location.
C. It produces better sound quality.
D. It replaces traditional choir performances entirely.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出虚拟合唱团让世界各地的歌手无需在同一地点就能一起表演，Whitacre认为它展示了技术如何通过音乐连接人们，打破地理障碍。
past_exams.answer: B。虚拟合唱团的主要优势是连接全球歌手，不受地理位置限制。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"音乐的影响"的短文。请你写一篇文章，分享音乐对你生活的影响。
范文：
The Impact of Music on My Life
Music has always been an important part of my life. Not only does it bring me joy, but it also helps me through difficult times.
When I feel stressed, listening to calming music helps me relax. Moved by beautiful melodies, I often forget my worries. Music also inspires me. Faced with challenges, I find strength in uplifting songs that encourage me to keep going. In addition, learning to play the guitar has improved my concentration and creativity.
In short, music is more than just entertainment. It is a powerful force that can heal the soul and connect people across cultures. I believe everyone should find the music that speaks to their heart.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查音乐影响短文写作。①使用过去分词作状语（Moved by..., Faced with...）；②倒装句（Not only does it...）；③结构清晰（引言→分述影响→总结）；④语言真挚。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：分词结构、倒装句式、内容充实、语言流畅。

chapters.title: Unit 1 Festivals and Celebrations 节日
chapters.summary: 话题：世界节日与庆祝。语法：情态动词。写作：节日介绍。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: festival 节日（the Spring Festival 春节）；celebrate 庆祝（celebration n. 庆祝活动）；origin 起源（originate v. 起源于）；religious 宗教的（religion n. 宗教）；custom 习俗（traditional customs 传统习俗）；gather 聚集（gathering n. 聚会）；feast 盛宴（have a feast 享用盛宴）；gratitude 感激（express gratitude 表达感激）；joy 喜悦（joyful adj. 快乐的）；decorate 装饰（decoration n. 装饰）；symbol 象征/符号（symbolize v. 象征）。词汇辨析：custom指群体长期形成的习俗；habit指个人的习惯。celebrate指以隆重方式庆祝；congratulate指对个人的祝贺（congratulate sb. on sth.）。origin指事物的起源；source指信息或资源的来源。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: in spite of 尽管（= despite，后接名词不接从句）；range from...to... 范围从……到……；dress up 打扮/穿上盛装（dress up as 打扮成）；after all 毕竟/终究（放在句首表"毕竟"，放在句末表"终究"）；be grateful for 感激（= be thankful for）；figure out 弄明白/算出。易错提示：in spite of后接名词或动名词，不接句子（接句子用although/though）。after all在句首意为"毕竟"（表示解释原因），在句末意为"终究"（表示与预期相反）。dress up后接as表示"打扮成"，接in表示"穿着"。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①情态动词表能力、许可、必须、建议等。例：You should respect different cultures. 你应该尊重不同文化。②No matter how... 无论怎样……。例：No matter how busy he is, he always spends time with his family. 无论多忙，他总是花时间陪家人。③It is a time when... 这是一个……的时期。例：It is a time when families gather together. 这是家人团聚的时期。注意：It is a time when后用一般现在时；It was a time when后用一般过去时或过去进行时。

knowledge.title: 语法：情态动词
knowledge.content: 情态动词表不同的意义：①can/could表能力（I can swim. 我会游泳）或许可（Can I help you? 我能帮你吗？）。②may/might表许可（May I come in? 我可以进来吗？）或推测（He may be at home. 他可能在家）。③must表必须（You must finish it today. 你必须今天完成），其否定形式needn't表示"不必"（不能用mustn't，mustn't表示"禁止"）。④should/ought to表建议或劝告（You should stop smoking. 你应该戒烟）。⑤shall表征求意见（Shall we go? 我们去吗？）或命令/威胁（You shall do as I say. 你必须照我说的做）。⑥will/would表意愿（I will help you. 我愿意帮你）或习惯（He would sit there for hours. 他过去常在那里坐几小时）。情态动词表推测（高频考点）：①肯定推测用must be（一定是）或must be doing（一定正在）。例：He must be at home now. 他现在一定在家。②否定推测用can't be（不可能）。例：He can't be at home; I just saw him at school. 他不可能在家，我刚在学校看到他。③可能推测用may/might be（可能）。例：He may be at the library. 他可能在图书馆。must与have to的区别：must强调主观看法"必须"；have to强调客观需要"不得不"。must只有现在时，have to有各种时态。学习提示：情态动词后接动词原形；表推测时must只用于肯定句，can't只用于否定句，may/might用于肯定或否定句。

exam_points.title: 情态动词
exam_points.content: 情态动词是高考必考语法点。解题技巧：①根据语境判断情态动词的意义——能力、许可、必须、建议、推测等。②must表必须时，其否定形式是needn't（不必），不是mustn't（禁止）。③表推测：肯定用must（一定），否定用can't（不可能），可能用may/might（可能）。④must与have to的区别：must主观，have to客观；must无时态变化，have to有各种时态。⑤shall在疑问句中用于第一人称表征求意见（Shall I/we...?），在陈述句中用于第二/三人称表命令/威胁/允诺。⑥should/ought to表建议"应该"。高频考点：must表推测与must表必须的辨析；mustn't（禁止）与needn't（不必）的区分。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①celebrate/celebration：celebrate v. 庆祝（celebrate a festival 庆祝节日）；celebration n. 庆祝活动（in celebration of 为庆祝……）。②custom/habit辨析：custom指社会、群体长期形成的习俗（the custom of giving red envelopes 发红包的习俗）；habit指个人长期养成的习惯（the habit of reading 阅读的习惯）。③origin/source：origin指事物的起源、由来（the origin of the festival 节日的起源）；source指信息、消息或资源的来源（the source of the news 消息来源）。解题技巧：社会习俗用custom，个人习惯用habit；节日起源用origin，消息来源用source。

exam_points.title: 节日介绍写作
exam_points.content: 节日介绍是高考应用文写作常见题型。写作要点：①结构：节日名称及时间→起源/历史→庆祝活动/习俗→意义/感受。②常用表达：fall on 落在（某日）；date back to 追溯到；in memory of 为了纪念；have a long history 有悠久历史；gather together 聚在一起；have a feast 享用盛宴；set off firecrackers 放鞭炮；exchange gifts 交换礼物；express gratitude 表达感激。③时态：介绍由来和历史用过去时，描述现在庆祝活动用现在时。④连接词：First, Besides, What's more, In addition, Finally。学习提示：节日介绍要涵盖时间、起源、活动、意义四个方面，内容要充实有条理。

examples.title: 情态动词表禁止（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：You ______ not park here; it's forbidden.
examples.analysis: 本题考查情态动词表禁止的用法。分析语境："it's forbidden"（禁止停车），表示"必须不/禁止"。must not / mustn't表示"禁止、不允许"，语气强烈。因此填must。解题技巧：must的两种否定含义——mustn't表示"禁止、不允许"（主观上强烈不允许）；needn't表示"不必"（不需要，must表必须的否定）。看到forbidden, not allowed, prohibited等词，用mustn't。
examples.answer: must。must not (mustn't)表示"禁止"，与forbidden呼应。

examples.title: 情态动词表推测（中档题）
examples.question: 改写：I'm sure he is the thief. → He ______ be the thief.
examples.analysis: 本题考查情态动词表肯定推测。分析语境："I'm sure"表示"我确信"，即非常肯定的推测。情态动词中，must表示最有把握的肯定推测（"一定是"）。因此填must。He must be the thief. 他一定是小偷。解题技巧：①肯定推测用must be（一定）：He must be a teacher. 他一定是老师。②否定推测用can't be（不可能）：He can't be a teacher. 他不可能是老师。③可能推测用may/might be（可能）：He may be a teacher. 他可能是老师。注意：must表推测只用于肯定句，否定推测用can't不用mustn't。
examples.answer: must。肯定推测用must be，表示"一定是"。

examples.title: must与needn't（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：— Must I finish the report today? — No, you ______. You can hand it in tomorrow. A. mustn't B. needn't C. can't D. shouldn't
examples.analysis: 本题考查must引导的疑问句的回答。分析语境：问句"Must I finish the report today?"（我必须今天完成报告吗？），答语"No"（不），且后面补充"You can hand it in tomorrow"（你可以明天交），说明"不必"今天完成。must的否定回答用needn't（不必），不用mustn't（禁止）。因此选B. needn't。解题技巧：Must I...? 的肯定回答用Yes, you must.（是的，必须）；否定回答用No, you needn't.（不，不必）。mustn't表示"禁止"，不用于must疑问句的否定回答。这是高考高频考点。
examples.answer: B. needn't。Must提问的否定回答用needn't，表示"不必"。

examples.title: 词汇辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：It is a Chinese ______ to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival, and it has become my ______ to make dumplings every year. A. custom; habit B. habit; custom C. custom; custom D. habit; habit
examples.analysis: 本题考查custom和habit的辨析。分析两个空格：①第一空语境"春节吃饺子是中国的______"，指社会群体长期形成的习俗，用custom。②第二空语境"每年包饺子已成为我的______"，指个人长期养成的习惯，用habit。因此选A. custom; habit。解题技巧：custom指社会、民族、群体长期形成的传统习俗（social custom 社会习俗；traditional custom 传统习俗）；habit指个人长期养成的行为习惯（personal habit 个人习惯；good/bad habit 好/坏习惯）。
examples.answer: A. custom; habit。custom指社会习俗；habit指个人习惯。

past_exams.question: You ______ not park here; it's forbidden.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查情态动词表禁止。"it's forbidden"表示禁止，must not/mustn't表示"禁止、不允许"，语气强烈。
past_exams.answer: must。must not (mustn't)表示"禁止"，与forbidden呼应。

past_exams.question:
— Must I finish the report today? — No, you ______. You can hand it in tomorrow.
A. mustn't  B. needn't  C. can't  D. shouldn't
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查must疑问句的否定回答。Must I...?的否定回答用needn't（不必），不用mustn't（禁止）。
past_exams.answer: B. needn't。Must提问的否定回答用needn't，表示"不必"。

past_exams.question:
It is a Chinese ______ to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival, and it has become my ______ to make dumplings every year.
A. custom; habit  B. habit; custom  C. custom; custom  D. habit; habit
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"春节吃饺子是中国的______"，指社会习俗用custom。第二空"每年包饺子已成为我的______"，指个人习惯用habit。
past_exams.answer: A. custom; habit。custom指社会习俗；habit指个人习惯。

past_exams.question: I'm sure he is the thief. → He ______ be the thief.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查情态动词表肯定推测。"I'm sure"表示非常肯定的推测，用must（一定）。
past_exams.answer: must。肯定推测用must be，表示"一定是"。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：The Spring Festival is the most important traditional ______ in China. Families ______ together for a reunion dinner. People ______ their houses with red decorations and set off firecrackers to celebrate.
A. holiday; gather; decorate  B. holiday; gather; build  C. festival; gather; decorate  D. festival; leave; decorate
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"最重要的传统节日"用festival。第二空"家人聚在一起"用gather。第三空"装饰房屋"用decorate。
past_exams.answer: C. festival; gather; decorate。festival节日；gather聚集；decorate装饰。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Thanksgiving is celebrated in the United States on the fourth Thursday of November. It originated as a harvest festival, where people gave thanks for a good harvest. Today, families gather for a large feast that typically includes turkey, pumpkin pie, and other traditional foods. The holiday also marks the beginning of the holiday shopping season.
What was the original purpose of Thanksgiving?
A. To start the shopping season.
B. To give thanks for a good harvest.
C. To eat turkey and pumpkin pie.
D. To gather with friends.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出感恩节"originated as a harvest festival, where people gave thanks for a good harvest"，最初是作为丰收节日，感谢丰收。
past_exams.answer: B。感恩节最初是为了感谢丰收。

past_exams.question: ______ busy he is, he always spends time with his family during festivals.（用no matter how句型）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查No matter how...句型。No matter how = However，后接形容词或副词。原句busy是形容词。
past_exams.answer: No matter how。No matter how = However，后接形容词busy。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：Why are festivals important?
___1___ Festivals help preserve cultural traditions and pass them down to future generations.
___2___ They bring families and communities together, strengthening social bonds.
___3___ Festivals often boost local economies through tourism and related activities.
A. Preserving culture.  B. Building relationships.  C. Boosting economy.  D. Wasting money.  E. Causing conflicts.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"保存文化传统"，对应A。第二段讲"让家庭和社区聚在一起"，对应B。第三段讲"促进地方经济"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调文化传承、增进关系和促进经济。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Festivals around the world share some common features despite their cultural differences. Most festivals involve special foods, decorations, and gatherings. However, the way they are celebrated varies greatly. For example, while Western festivals often emphasize individual expression, many Asian festivals focus more on family harmony and respect for ancestors.
What does the passage suggest about festivals?
A. All festivals are celebrated in the same way worldwide.
B. Festivals share common features but are celebrated differently across cultures.
C. Asian festivals are better than Western festivals.
D. Western festivals do not involve food or gatherings.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出世界各地的节日有共同特征（食物、装饰、聚会），但庆祝方式因文化而异。西方强调个人表达，亚洲注重家庭和谐和尊敬祖先。
past_exams.answer: B。节日有共同特征但庆祝方式因文化不同而有所差异。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你的英国笔友Tom想了解中国的春节。请你写一封邮件，向他介绍春节。
范文：
Dear Tom,
I'm glad to tell you about the Spring Festival, the most important traditional festival in China.
It falls on the first day of the Chinese lunar new year. The festival has a long history dating back thousands of years. Before the festival, families clean their houses and put up red decorations. On New Year's Eve, family members gather together for a reunion dinner. We eat dumplings and watch the Spring Festival Gala. Children receive red envelopes containing lucky money. People also set off firecrackers to celebrate.
No matter how busy people are, they always try to return home for the reunion. It is a time for family, gratitude, and hope.
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查节日介绍写作。①结构清晰（时间→历史→习俗→意义）；②时态恰当（历史用过去时，习俗用现在时）；③使用No matter how句型；④内容充实。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：结构完整、内容充实、时态正确、句式多样。

chapters.title: Unit 2 Morals and Virtues 道德与美德
chapters.summary: 话题：道德困境与美德（以林巧稚为例）。语法：情态动词表推测。写作：美德故事/观点。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: moral 道德的/寓意（moral standards 道德标准）；virtue 美德（traditional virtues 传统美德）；dilemma 困境/进退两难（face a dilemma 面临困境）；faint 晕倒/微弱的（faint at the sight of blood 一见血就晕）；complain 抱怨（complain about sth. 抱怨某事；complaint n. 抱怨）；respond 回应（respond to sth. 回应某事；response n. 回应）；reject 拒绝（rejection n. 拒绝）；tend 照顾/趋向（tend sb. 照顾某人；tend to do 倾向于做）；retire 退休（retired adj. 退休的；retirement n. 退休）；principle 原则（stick to one's principles 坚持原则）；significant 重要的（significance n. 重要性）。词汇辨析：reject指坚决拒绝、不接受；refuse指一般性拒绝；decline指委婉拒绝。respond较正式；answer较口语；reply指回复。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: carry sb. through 帮某人渡过难关/坚持到底；in trouble 处于困境（get into trouble 陷入麻烦）；be known for 因……闻名（be known as 作为……闻名；be known to 为……所熟知）；first aid 急救（give first aid 进行急救）；in despair 绝望地（in hope 充满希望地）；be responsible for 对……负责。易错提示：be known for后接出名的原因（因……闻名）；be known as后接身份或名称（作为……闻名）；be known to后接人（为……所熟知）。carry sb. through后接困难时期或难关，不接具体事物。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①情态动词表推测（must/may/might/can't + do/be doing/have done）。例：He must have finished the work yesterday. 他昨天一定完成了工作。It can't be true. 这不可能是真的。②It is worthwhile to do/doing... 值得做……。例：It is worthwhile to help others. 帮助他人是值得的。③Rather than..., sb. did... 某人没有……而是……。例：Rather than give up, she chose to continue. 她没有放弃，而是选择继续。注意：rather than连接的两个部分结构要一致。

knowledge.title: 语法：情态动词表推测
knowledge.content: 情态动词表推测是高考重点语法。推测的确定程度：must > should > may > might。①对现在情况的推测：肯定用must be/do（一定），may/might be/do（可能），can't be/do（不可能）。例：He must be in the office now. 他现在一定在办公室。He can't be hungry; he just ate. 他不可能饿，刚吃过。②对正在进行的动作的推测：must be doing（一定正在），may be doing（可能正在），can't be doing（不可能正在）。例：He must be sleeping now. 他现在一定在睡觉。③对过去情况的推测：must have done（一定做过），may/might have done（可能做过），can't have done（不可能做过），should have done（本该做过但没做），needn't have done（本不必做但做了）。例：The ground is wet. It must have rained last night. 地面湿了，昨晚一定下雨了。You should have told me earlier. 你本该早点告诉我。注意事项：①must表推测只用于肯定句，否定句用can't。②can/could表推测可用于否定句和疑问句，不用于肯定句。③对过去的推测中，must have done（一定做过）和should have done（本该做但没做）含义不同。学习提示：做情态动词推测题的关键——先判断推测的时间（现在/过去），再判断肯定还是否定推测。

exam_points.title: 情态动词表推测
exam_points.content: 情态动词表推测是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①判断推测时间——对现在推测用must/may/can't + do/be doing；对过去推测用must/may/can't + have done。②判断肯定/否定——肯定推测用must（一定），否定推测用can't（不可能），可能推测用may/might（可能）。③must have done表示"过去一定做过"（肯定推测）；should have done表示"本该做但没做"（责备/遗憾）；could have done表示"本可以做但没做"（遗憾）；needn't have done表示"本不必做但做了"。④can't have done表示"过去不可能做过"（否定推测）。高频考点：must have done与should have done的区别——must have done是推测"一定做了"，should have done是责备"本该做但没做"。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①respond/response：respond v. 回应（respond to sth. 回应某事）；response n. 回应（in response to 作为对……的回应；make a response 作出回应）。②reject/refuse/decline辨析：reject指坚决拒绝、不接受（reject a proposal 拒绝提议）；refuse指一般性拒绝（refuse to do 拒绝做某事）；decline指委婉拒绝（decline an invitation 婉拒邀请）。③tend/tendency：tend v. 照顾/趋向（tend to do 倾向于做某事）；tendency n. 趋向（have a tendency to do 有做某事的倾向）。解题技巧：reject语气最强，refuse次之，decline最委婉。refuse后接to do，reject后接名词。

exam_points.title: 写作
exam_points.content: 美德故事/观点写作是高考常见题型。写作要点：①结构：引出话题（美德的重要性）→叙述故事（具体事例）→分析议论（美德的意义）→总结呼吁。②常用表达：moral virtue 道德美德；face a moral dilemma 面临道德困境；stick to one's principles 坚持原则；help others 帮助他人；be responsible for 对……负责；set a good example 树立榜样；make a difference 产生影响。③夹叙夹议：先叙述故事经过，再发表观点和感受。④常用句式：It is a virtue to do...; We should always keep in mind that...; Only by doing... can we...。学习提示：美德故事要真实感人，议论部分要与故事紧密结合，避免空谈。

examples.title: 推测过去（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：The ground is wet. It ______ ______ rained last night.
examples.analysis: 本题考查情态动词对过去情况的肯定推测。分析步骤：①语境"地面湿了"，推断"昨晚一定下雨了"，是对过去事情的肯定推测。②对过去的肯定推测用must have done（一定做过）。③rain的过去分词是rained。因此填must have。解题技巧：看到对过去的肯定推测（一定是做了某事），用must have + 过去分词。must have done表示对过去事情的肯定推测，意为"一定做过某事"。
examples.answer: must have。对过去肯定推测用must have done。

examples.title: 否定推测（中档题）
examples.question: 填空：He ______ be at home; I just saw him at school.
examples.analysis: 本题考查情态动词的否定推测。分析步骤：①语境"我刚在学校看到他了"，推断"他不可能在家"，是否定推测。②否定推测用can't（不可能），不用mustn't。③对现在的否定推测用can't be/do。因此填can't。解题技巧：肯定推测用must（一定），否定推测用can't（不可能），不能用mustn't。mustn't表示"禁止"而非"不可能"。这是高考高频易错点。
examples.answer: can't。否定推测用can't，表示"不可能"。

examples.title: should have done（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：You ______ told me about the change earlier. Now it's too late. A. should have B. must have C. could D. might
examples.analysis: 本题考查should have done表责备的用法。分析语境："你本该早点告诉我变化。现在太迟了。"表示本该做某事但没做，带有责备/遗憾语气。should have done表示"本该做某事但实际没做"，用于责备或遗憾。must have done表示"一定做过"（推测），不合语境；could和might后接原形不接have done。因此选A. should have。解题技巧：①should have done = 本该做但没做（责备/遗憾）；②must have done = 一定做过（肯定推测）；③could have done = 本可以做但没做（遗憾）；④needn't have done = 本不必做但做了（后悔）。这些结构都表示对过去的虚拟或推测。
examples.answer: A. should have。should have done表示"本该做但没做"，表责备。

examples.title: 词汇辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：She politely ______ the invitation to the party because she had to study for the exam. A. rejected B. refused C. declined D. denied
examples.analysis: 本题考查表示"拒绝"的近义词辨析。分析语境：关键词"politely"（礼貌地），表示委婉拒绝。四个选项：rejected指坚决拒绝、不接受，语气最强；refused指一般性拒绝，语气较强；declined指委婉拒绝，语气最温和，符合"politely"的语境；denied指否认、否定，不表示"拒绝邀请"。因此选C. declined。解题技巧：拒绝的程度从强到弱：reject > refuse > decline。看到politely/gently等词优先选decline；看到坚决拒绝/不接受用reject；一般拒绝用refuse。denied是"否认"，不是"拒绝"。
examples.answer: C. declined。decline指委婉拒绝，与politely呼应。

past_exams.question: The ground is wet. It ______ ______ rained last night.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查情态动词对过去的肯定推测。"地面湿了"推断"昨晚一定下雨了"，对过去的肯定推测用must have done。
past_exams.answer: must have。对过去肯定推测用must have done。

past_exams.question: He ______ be at home; I just saw him at school.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查情态动词的否定推测。"我刚在学校看到他了"推断"他不可能在家"，否定推测用can't（不可能）。
past_exams.answer: can't。否定推测用can't，表示"不可能"。

past_exams.question:
You ______ told me about the change earlier. Now it's too late.
A. should have  B. must have  C. could  D. might
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查should have done表责备。"你本该早点告诉我"表示本该做但没做，带有责备语气。
past_exams.answer: A. should have。should have done表示"本该做但没做"，表责备。

past_exams.question:
She politely ______ the invitation to the party because she had to study for the exam.
A. rejected  B. refused  C. declined  D. denied
past_exams.analysis: 关键词"politely"（礼貌地），表示委婉拒绝。decline指委婉拒绝，语气最温和，符合语境。reject语气最强，refuse一般拒绝，deny是"否认"。
past_exams.answer: C. declined。decline指委婉拒绝，与politely呼应。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：Lin Qiaozhi was a remarkable doctor who faced many moral ______ in her career. Once, she was about to leave for a study abroad opportunity when a patient was brought in. ______ than leave, she chose to stay and treat the patient. Her ______ to medicine earned her great respect.
A. dilemmas; Rather  B. choices; Rather  C. dilemmas; Instead  D. choices; Instead
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"道德困境"用moral dilemmas。第二空"Rather than leave"（而不是离开），rather than连接平行结构。
past_exams.answer: A. dilemmas; Rather。moral dilemma道德困境；Rather than而不是。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：When people face moral dilemmas, their decisions often reveal their true character. Research shows that individuals who consistently make ethical choices, even at personal cost, tend to have higher self-esteem and life satisfaction. However, the study also found that social pressure can significantly influence moral decision-making, sometimes leading people to act against their own values.
What does the research suggest about moral decision-making?
A. It has no effect on personal well-being.
B. Ethical choices are linked to higher self-esteem, but social pressure can influence decisions.
C. Social pressure always leads to better decisions.
D. People always act according to their values.
past_exams.analysis: 研究表明做出道德选择的人自尊和生活满意度更高，但社会压力会影响道德决策，有时导致人们违背自己的价值观。
past_exams.answer: B。道德选择与高自尊相关，但社会压力会影响决策。

past_exams.question: The ground is dry. It ______ have rained last night.（填否定推测）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查对过去的否定推测。"地面是干的"推断"昨晚不可能下雨了"，对过去的否定推测用can't have done。
past_exams.answer: can't。对过去的否定推测用can't have done，表示"不可能做过"。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to make ethical decisions?
___1___ Take time to think about the consequences of your actions before making a decision.
___2___ Consider how your decision will affect others, not just yourself.
___3___ Stick to your principles even when facing pressure from others.
A. Think about consequences.  B. Consider others.  C. Stick to principles.  D. Follow the crowd.  E. Ignore the impact.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"思考后果"，对应A。第二段讲"考虑他人"，对应B。第三段讲"坚持原则"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调考虑后果、关心他人和坚持原则。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The trolley problem is a famous ethical dilemma. A runaway trolley is heading toward five people tied to the tracks. You can pull a lever to divert it to another track, where it will kill one person instead. Most people say they would pull the lever, choosing to save five lives at the cost of one. However, when the dilemma is modified so that one must actively push someone onto the tracks to stop the trolley, far fewer people are willing to act, despite the same outcome.
Why do fewer people act in the modified version of the trolley problem?
A. Because the outcome is different.
B. Because actively causing harm feels morally different from allowing harm indirectly.
C. Because they don't understand the problem.
D. Because they want to save only one person.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出虽然结果相同（牺牲一人救五人），但主动推人比拉拉杆间接造成伤害在道德感受上不同，因此更少人愿意行动。
past_exams.answer: B。主动造成伤害与间接造成伤害在道德感受上不同。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"美德故事"的文章。请你写一篇文章，分享一个关于诚实美德的故事。
范文：
The Power of Honesty
Honesty is one of the most important virtues in our lives. I learned this lesson from an experience last year.
One day, I found a wallet on my way home. It contained a large amount of money and an ID card. Faced with the temptation to keep it, I hesitated for a moment. However, I remembered my parents' teaching: honesty is always the right choice. Rather than keep the money, I turned the wallet in to the police station.
The owner, an elderly woman, was extremely grateful. She said the money was for her medical bills. At that moment, I realized that honesty is not just about doing the right thing; it can also make a real difference in someone's life. We should always stick to our principles, no matter how difficult it may be.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查美德故事写作。①夹叙夹议（叙述故事+发表议论）；②使用过去分词状语（Faced with...）；③使用Rather than句型；④主题突出，有教育意义。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：叙述生动、议论恰当、句式多样、主题突出。

chapters.title: Unit 3 Diverse Cultures 多元文化
chapters.summary: 话题：多元文化（以旧金山为例）。语法：it 的用法。写作：城市/文化介绍。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: diverse 多样的/不同的（diversity n. 多样性；diversify v. 使多样化）；fortune 财富/运气（fortunate adj. 幸运的；fortunately adv. 幸运地；unfortunate adj. 不幸的）；immigrant 移民（immigrate v. 移居；emigrate v. 移出）；contain 包含（container n. 容器）；district 地区/区域；material 材料/物质（materials 原材料）；construction 建设（construct v. 建设）；definitely 肯定地/明确地（definite adj. 明确的）；historical 历史的（historic 具有历史意义的）。词汇辨析：diverse强调多种多样的、不同的；different强调不同的。contain指包含/容纳（内部含有）；include指包括（作为整体的一部分）。historical指历史的（与历史有关的）；historic指具有历史意义的（历史上著名的）。fortune指财富或运气；wealth指财富。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: head to 前往（= head for）；seek one's fortune 寻找发财机会/淘金；a variety of 各种各样（= varieties of / various）；bring about 引起/导致（= cause/lead to）；apart from 除了（= besides/except）；settle in 定居于/习惯于。易错提示：apart from既可表示"除了……还（有）"（= besides），也可表示"除了……（没有）"（= except），需根据语境判断。head to和head for都表示"前往"，可互换。a variety of后接可数名词复数，谓语动词用复数。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①It is + adj./n. + that... 做某事是……的。例：It is important that we respect different cultures. 尊重不同文化很重要。②It takes sb. time to do sth. 花某人时间做某事。例：It took me three hours to finish the essay. 写完这篇文章花了我三小时。③It is... that...（强调句）。例：It was in San Francisco that I first experienced diverse cultures. 就是在旧金山我第一次体验了多元文化。注意：强调句去掉It is/was...that后，句子仍完整；而定语从句去掉后句子不完整。

knowledge.title: 语法：it 的用法
knowledge.content: it在英语中用途广泛，主要用法：①作代词：a) 指代前文提到的事物或动物。例：I bought a book. It is very interesting. b) 指代天气、时间、距离、温度等。例：It is raining.（天气）It is 7 o'clock.（时间）It is two miles from here.（距离）c) 指代不明身份的人或婴儿。例：— Who is it? — It's me. ②作形式主语：真正的主语（不定式、动名词、that从句）后置。例：It is important to learn English.（to learn English是真正主语）It is no use crying over spilt milk.（crying是真正主语）It is said that he is a genius.（that从句是真正主语）③作形式宾语：真正的宾语后置，it放在宾语位置。例：I find it difficult to learn English.（to learn English是真正宾语）I think it important that we should work hard.（that从句是真正宾语）④强调句型：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其余部分。可强调主语、宾语、状语等。例：It was Tom who/that broke the window.（强调主语Tom）It was the window that Tom broke.（强调宾语）It was in the park that I met him.（强调地点状语）强调句的判断方法：去掉It is/was...that/who后，如果剩余部分仍是一个完整的句子，就是强调句；如果不完整，就不是。⑤常用it句型：It is said that... 据说；It is reported that... 据报道；It is well known that... 众所周知；It seems that... 似乎；It happens that... 碰巧。学习提示：强调句的判断是高考重点——去掉It is/was...that后看句子是否完整。

exam_points.title: it 用法
exam_points.content: it的用法是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①形式主语/宾语：判断真正的主语/宾语是什么——不定式、动名词或that从句。常见句型：It is + adj. + for sb. to do sth.；It is no use doing sth.；It is said that...；find/make/think it + adj. + to do sth.。②强调句判断：去掉It is/was...that/who后句子仍完整→是强调句；不完整→不是强调句（可能是定语从句或其他句型）。例：It was in 1990 that he was born.（去掉后In 1990 he was born.仍完整→强调句）It was 1990 when he was born.（去掉后1990 he was born.不完整→定语从句，when作状语）。③强调句的强调部分：可强调主语、宾语、状语，但不能强调谓语动词。强调人用who/that，强调物/时间/地点等用that。④强调句的疑问形式：Was it...that...? / What is/was it that...?。高频考点：强调句与定语从句的区分。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①diverse/diversity/diversify：diverse adj. 多样的（a diverse culture 多元文化）；diversity n. 多样性（cultural diversity 文化多样性）；diversify v. 使多样化。②contain/include辨析：contain指"包含、含有"（强调内部含有某物，不一定包括全部）。例：The box contains books. 盒子里装有书。include指"包括"（强调作为整体的一部分）。例：The price includes tax. 价格包括税。③historical/historic辨析：historical指"历史的、与历史有关的"（historical events 历史事件；historical research 历史研究）；historic指"具有历史意义的、历史上著名的"（a historic moment 历史性时刻；a historic building 历史建筑）。解题技巧：contain侧重"内容物"，include侧重"包括范围"；historical侧重"与历史相关"，historic侧重"有历史意义"。

exam_points.title: 文化介绍写作
exam_points.content: 城市/文化介绍是高考写作常见题型。写作要点：①结构：位置概况→历史背景→文化特色→著名景点→个人感受/推荐。②常用表达：be located/situated in 位于；has a population of 有……人口；has a long history 有悠久历史；be famous for 以……著名；a cultural melting pot 文化大熔炉；diverse cultures 多元文化；a must-visit place 必去之地；experience different cultures 体验不同文化。③时态：介绍历史用过去时，描述现状用现在时。④连接词：First, Besides, In addition, What's more, Finally。⑤可用强调句和it句型丰富表达：It is in this city that you can experience diverse cultures. 正是在这座城市你可以体验多元文化。学习提示：文化介绍要突出特色，涵盖历史、文化、景点等多方面，适当使用高级句型提升档次。

examples.title: 强调句（基础题）
examples.question: 对画线部分强调：I met Tom in the park yesterday.（强调 in the park）
examples.analysis: 本题考查强调句的构成。分析步骤：①强调句结构：It is/was + 强调部分 + that + 句子其余部分。②原句是一般过去时，用It was。③强调部分是in the park（地点状语）。④其余部分是I met Tom yesterday。⑤强调物/地点/时间用that。因此构成：It was in the park that I met Tom yesterday.
examples.answer: It was in the park that I met Tom yesterday.

examples.title: 形式宾语（中档题）
examples.question: 填空：I find ______ important to learn English well.
examples.analysis: 本题考查it作形式宾语的用法。分析步骤：①句型结构：find + 宾语 + 宾补（important）。②真正的宾语是to learn English well（不定式），但不定式较长，放在宾补后面会使句子头重脚轻。③用it作形式宾语放在宾语位置，真正宾语to learn English well后置。④因此填it。解题技巧：find/make/think/feel等动词后如果宾语是不定式、动名词或that从句，且后面有宾补，常用it作形式宾语，真正宾语后置。
examples.answer: it。it作形式宾语，真正宾语为to learn English well。

examples.title: 强调句判断（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：It was not until midnight ______ he came back home. A. that B. when C. since D. as
examples.analysis: 本题考查强调句的判断及not until的强调结构。分析步骤：①原句为He did not come back home until midnight.（他直到午夜才回家）。②强调not until midnight部分，用强调句结构：It was not until midnight that he came back home. ③判断方法：去掉It was...that后，剩余"not until midnight he came back home"仍是一个完整句子（Not until midnight did he come back home.的变体），说明是强调句。④not until的强调句固定用that，不用when。因此选A. that。解题技巧：It is/was not until...that...是固定强调句型，表示"直到……才"。
examples.answer: A. that。not until的强调句固定用that。

examples.title: 词汇辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The museum ______ many ancient artifacts, and the ticket price also ______ a guided tour. A. contains; includes B. includes; contains C. contains; contains D. includes; includes
examples.analysis: 本题考查contain和include的辨析。分析两个空格：①第一空语境"博物馆______许多古代文物"，指博物馆内部含有/容纳文物，用contains。②第二空语境"票价也______导游服务"，指导游服务作为票价整体的一部分被包括在内，用includes。因此选A. contains; includes。解题技巧：contain侧重"内容物"（容器里装着什么），不强调是否是整体的一部分；include侧重"包括范围"（某物作为整体的一部分被包含）。
examples.answer: A. contains; includes。contain指内部含有；include指作为整体的一部分包括。

past_exams.question: 对画线部分强调：I met Tom in the park yesterday.（强调 in the park）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查强调句的构成。强调句结构：It is/was + 强调部分 + that + 句子其余部分。原句一般过去时用It was，强调地点用that。
past_exams.answer: It was in the park that I met Tom yesterday.

past_exams.question: I find ______ important to learn English well.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查it作形式宾语。find + it（形式宾语）+ important（宾补）+ to learn English well（真正宾语）。真正宾语是不定式，用it作形式宾语后置。
past_exams.answer: it。it作形式宾语，真正宾语为to learn English well。

past_exams.question:
The museum ______ many ancient artifacts, and the ticket price also ______ a guided tour.
A. contains; includes  B. includes; contains  C. contains; contains  D. includes; includes
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"博物馆容纳文物"用contains（内部含有）。第二空"票价包括导游服务"用includes（作为整体的一部分包括）。
past_exams.answer: A. contains; includes。contain指内部含有；include指作为整体的一部分包括。

past_exams.question:
It was not until midnight ______ he came back home.
A. that  B. when  C. since  D. as
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查not until的强调句型。It is/was not until...that...是固定强调句型，表示"直到……才"，固定用that。
past_exams.answer: A. that。not until的强调句固定用that。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：San Francisco is known for its ______ cultures. Immigrants from all over the world have ______ here, bringing their traditions and customs. The city is ______ a cultural melting pot.
A. diverse; settled; definitely  B. different; arrived; definitely  C. diverse; left; possibly  D. same; settled; definitely
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"多元文化"用diverse cultures。第二空"定居"用settled。第三空"确实是文化大熔炉"用definitely（肯定地）。
past_exams.answer: A. diverse; settled; definitely。diverse多元的；settle定居；definitely肯定地。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：San Francisco's Chinatown is the oldest and one of the largest in North America. Established in the 1840s, it has been a center of Chinese culture and commerce for over 170 years. Visitors can experience authentic Chinese food, traditional medicine shops, and cultural festivals. Despite modernization, Chinatown has preserved its unique character and continues to be a bridge between Eastern and Western cultures.
What makes San Francisco's Chinatown special according to the passage?
A. It is the newest Chinatown in North America.
B. It has preserved its cultural character for over 170 years and bridges East and West.
C. It only sells modern products.
D. It has no cultural festivals.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出旧金山唐人街是北美最古老和最大的之一，已有170多年历史，保留了独特特色，是东西方文化的桥梁。
past_exams.answer: B。唐人街保存了文化特色170多年，是东西方文化的桥梁。

past_exams.question: ______ is reported that the cultural festival will attract thousands of visitors.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查It is reported that...句型。It作形式主语，that从句是真正主语。固定句型：It is said/reported/well known that...。
past_exams.answer: It。It作形式主语，that从句是真正主语。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：How to experience diverse cultures?
___1___ Travel to different countries and immerse yourself in local traditions.
___2___ Try foods from various cultures to understand their culinary heritage.
___3___ Learn a foreign language to connect with people from different backgrounds.
A. Travel and immerse.  B. Try diverse foods.  C. Learn languages.  D. Stay at home.  E. Avoid foreigners.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"去不同国家旅行，沉浸在传统中"，对应A。第二段讲"尝试各种文化的食物"，对应B。第三段讲"学习外语"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调旅行沉浸、品尝美食和学习语言。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Cultural diversity is not just about different foods, clothes, and festivals. It encompasses different ways of thinking, problem-solving, and viewing the world. Research has shown that diverse teams are often more creative and innovative, as members bring different perspectives. However, cultural diversity also presents challenges, such as communication barriers and potential misunderstandings. The key is to embrace differences while finding common ground.
What does the passage suggest about cultural diversity?
A. It only brings challenges with no benefits.
B. It promotes creativity but also presents communication challenges.
C. It is only about different foods and festivals.
D. It always leads to misunderstandings.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出文化多样性促进创造力和创新（积极面），但也带来沟通障碍和误解（消极面），关键是在拥抱差异的同时找到共同点。
past_exams.answer: B。文化多样性促进创造力但也带来沟通挑战。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你的外国朋友Tom想了解一座中国多元文化城市。请你写一封邮件，向他介绍香港。
范文：
Dear Tom,
I'm glad to recommend Hong Kong as a city where you can experience diverse cultures.
Located on the southern coast of China, Hong Kong is known as a cultural melting pot. It has a population of over 7 million people from various cultural backgrounds. It is in Hong Kong that you can experience the unique blend of Eastern and Western cultures.
The city is famous for its diverse cuisine, ranging from traditional Cantonese dim sum to Western fine dining. Historical sites, such as ancient temples, stand alongside modern skyscrapers. It is definitely a must-visit place for anyone interested in cultural diversity.
Yours,
Li Hua
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查城市/文化介绍。①使用强调句（It is in Hong Kong that...）；②过去分词作状语（Located on...）；③结构清晰（位置→特色→景点→推荐）；④内容充实。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：强调句使用、结构清晰、内容充实、语言流畅。

chapters.title: Unit 4 Space Exploration 太空探索
chapters.summary: 话题：太空探索历程。语法：不定式。写作：太空探索意义议论文。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: explore 探索（exploration n. 探索；explorer n. 探索者）；launch 发射（launch a rocket 发射火箭）；astronaut 宇航员；signal 信号（send a signal 发送信号）；intelligent 智能的（intelligence n. 智力）；determine 决心/决定（be determined to do 决心做某事；determination n. 决心）；independent 独立的（independence n. 独立；depend on 依赖）；limited 有限的（limit n./v. 限制）；vital 至关重要的（be vital to 对……至关重要）；mystery 谜（mysterious adj. 神秘的）。词汇辨析：explore强调探索未知领域；discover强调发现已存在的事物。intelligent指有智力的、聪明的；clever指机灵的、聪明的。vital指至关重要的；important指重要的。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: carry on 继续（carry on doing sth. 继续做某事）；on board 在船上/机上/车上；as a result 结果（as a result of 由于）；provide for 供养/提供；in closing 最后（= in conclusion）；run out 用完/耗尽（run out of 用完某物）。易错提示：carry on后接doing或with sth.，不接to do。run out主语是物（The water ran out. 水用完了）；run out of主语是人（I ran out of water. 我用完了水）。as a result后接结果句子；as a result of后接名词。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①It is + adj. + for sb. to do sth. 对某人来说做某事是……的。例：It is vital for us to explore space. 对我们来说探索太空至关重要。②To do... is... 不定式作主语（常以it作形式主语）。例：To master a language takes time. = It takes time to master a language. ③so as to / in order to 表目的。例：He got up early so as to catch the first bus. 他早起为了赶上首班车。注意：so as to不放句首，in order to可放句首。

knowledge.title: 语法：不定式
knowledge.content: 不定式由to + 动词原形构成，具有名词、形容词和副词功能。①作主语：To learn English is important. 常用It作形式主语：It is important to learn English. ②作宾语：want/decide/hope/plan/choose/offer/manage/refuse/agree/promise + to do。例：I decided to study abroad. ③作表语：主语 + be + to do。例：My dream is to become an astronaut. ④作定语：不定式作定语放在名词后，常表将来。例：I have a lot of work to do. There is nothing to worry about. ⑤作状语：a) 目的状语——I got up early to catch the bus. b) 结果状语——He is too tired to walk. / He is old enough to go to school. c) 原因状语——I am glad to see you. 否定形式：not to do。例：I decided not to go. 注意：①不定式作宾语时，有些动词后只接to do（decide, hope, plan, refuse等），有些只接doing（enjoy, finish, mind, suggest等），有些两者均可但含义不同（remember to do 记得要做 vs remember doing 记得做过；stop to do 停下来去做 vs stop doing 停止做）。②make up one's mind to do, be determined to do, would like to do。学习提示：高考常考不定式作主语、定语和目的状语，以及to do与doing的区别。

exam_points.title: 不定式
exam_points.content: 不定式是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①作各成分的辨析——判断不定式在句中的功能（主语/宾语/表语/定语/状语）。②不定式作定语表将来，常放在名词后。例：There is a meeting to attend tomorrow. ③不定式作目的状语用to do / in order to / so as to，so as to不放句首。④to do与doing的区别：a) 作宾语时，有些动词后只接to do（decide, hope, plan, refuse等），有些只接doing（enjoy, finish, mind, suggest等）；b) remember/forget/stop + to do（将要做）vs + doing（已做过）；c) try to do（努力做）vs try doing（尝试做）。⑤不定式的否定用not to do。高频考点：stop/remember/forget + to do vs doing 的区别。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①explore/exploration/explorer：explore v. 探索（explore the space 探索太空）；exploration n. 探索（space exploration 太空探索）；explorer n. 探索者。②determined/determine：determine v. 决定/决心（determine to do 决心做某事）；determined adj. 坚决的（be determined to do 决心做某事）；determination n. 决心。③run out/run out of：run out主语是物，意为"用完、耗尽"（The time ran out. 时间用完了）；run out of主语是人，意为"用完某物"（I ran out of time. 我用完了时间）。解题技巧：run out = be used up（主语是物）；run out of = use up（主语是人）。

exam_points.title: 议论文写作
exam_points.content: 太空探索意义是高考议论文写作题型。写作要点：①结构：引出话题（太空探索的现状）→分析意义（科学价值、技术进步、人类未来）→讨论争议（成本高、地球问题待解决）→表明立场→总结呼吁。②常用表达：explore the universe 探索宇宙；make breakthroughs 取得突破；benefit mankind 造福人类；advance technology 推动技术；solve the mystery of 解开……之谜；a waste of money 浪费金钱；focus on Earth's problems 关注地球问题。③常用句式：There is no doubt that...；It is worthwhile to...；Only by exploring...can we...。④连接词：First, Besides, What's more, However, In conclusion。学习提示：议论文要观点明确，论据充分，既要论述正面意义也要提及反面观点，最后表明自己的立场。

examples.title: 不定式作主语（基础题）
examples.question: 改写：To master a language is necessary. → It is necessary ______.
examples.analysis: 本题考查不定式作主语及it作形式主语的转换。分析步骤：①原句To master a language是真正主语，is necessary是系表结构。②用it作形式主语，把不定式后置：It is necessary to master a language. ③因此填to master a language。解题技巧：不定式作主语时，常用It is + adj. + to do sth.结构，it是形式主语，to do是真正主语。这样可以使句子更平衡，避免头重脚轻。
examples.answer: to master a language。it作形式主语，不定式后置。

examples.title: 不定式作目的状语（中档题）
examples.question: 翻译：他早起是为了赶上首班车。
examples.analysis: 本题考查不定式作目的状语。分析步骤：①"为了赶上首班车"表目的，用不定式to catch the first bus。②"早起"用get up early，"他"用he，时态用一般过去时got up。③完整句子：He got up early to catch the first bus. 也可用in order to或so as to：He got up early in order to catch the first bus. 解题技巧：表目的用不定式（to do / in order to / so as to）。in order to可放句首，so as to不能放句首。
examples.answer: He got up early to catch the first bus.

examples.title: to do与doing区别（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：— Remember ______ the door when you leave. — OK, I remember ______ it last time. A. to lock; locking B. locking; to lock C. to lock; to lock D. locking; locking
examples.analysis: 本题考查remember后接to do和doing的区别。分析两个空格：①第一空语境"离开时记得锁门"，表示将要做但还未做的事，用remember to do（记得要做某事）。②第二空语境"我记得上次锁过了"，表示已经做过的事，用remember doing（记得做过某事）。因此选A. to lock; locking。解题技巧：remember to do = 记得要做（还未做）；remember doing = 记得做过（已做）。类似用法的词还有：forget to do（忘记要做）vs forget doing（忘记做过）；stop to do（停下来去做）vs stop doing（停止做）。这是高考高频考点。
examples.answer: A. to lock; locking。remember to do记得要做；remember doing记得做过。

examples.title: run out用法（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 语法填空：We ______ (run) out of fuel and had to stop the car on the highway.
examples.analysis: 本题考查run out of的时态及用法。分析步骤：①语境"我们用完了燃油，不得不在高速公路上停车"。②run out of意为"用完某物"，主语是人（we）。③had to提示是过去发生的事，用一般过去时ran。④因此填ran。解题技巧：①run out of主语是人，意为"用完某物"（I ran out of money. 我用完了钱）。②run out主语是物，意为"被用完"（The money ran out. 钱用完了）。③两者意思相近但主语不同。时态由语境决定。
examples.answer: ran。run out of主语是人，语境为过去时用ran。

past_exams.question: To master a language is necessary. → It is necessary ______.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查不定式作主语及it作形式主语的转换。不定式作主语时常用It is + adj. + to do sth.结构，it是形式主语，to do是真正主语。
past_exams.answer: to master a language。it作形式主语，不定式后置。

past_exams.question:
— Remember ______ the door when you leave. — OK, I remember ______ it last time.
A. to lock; locking  B. locking; to lock  C. to lock; to lock  D. locking; locking
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"记得锁门"表示将要做的事，用remember to do。第二空"记得上次锁过了"表示已做的事，用remember doing。
past_exams.answer: A. to lock; locking。remember to do记得要做；remember doing记得做过。

past_exams.question: We ______ (run) out of fuel and had to stop the car on the highway.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查run out of的时态。run out of主语是人（we），意为"用完某物"。had to提示是过去的事，用一般过去时ran。
past_exams.answer: ran。run out of主语是人，语境为过去时用ran。

past_exams.question: He got up early ______ ______ (catch) the first bus.（用in order to填空）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查不定式作目的状语。"为了赶上首班车"表目的，用in order to catch。in order to可放句首，so as to不能放句首。
past_exams.answer: in order to catch。in order to表目的，可放句首或句中。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：Space exploration has always been a great ______ for humans. Scientists are ______ to find evidence of life on other planets. However, the resources for space exploration are ______, which means we must use them wisely.
A. mystery; determined; limited  B. mystery; decided; enough  C. question; determined; limited  D. mystery; determined; plenty
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"太空探索是巨大的谜"用mystery。第二空"科学家决心寻找"用are determined to。第三空"资源是有限的"用limited。
past_exams.answer: A. mystery; determined; limited。mystery谜；be determined to决心；limited有限的。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Since the first satellite was launched in 1957, space exploration has made remarkable progress. The Apollo missions landed humans on the Moon, and the Mars rovers have provided valuable data about the red planet. The International Space Station (ISS) has been continuously occupied since 2000, serving as a laboratory for scientific research. Despite these achievements, many challenges remain, including radiation exposure and the enormous cost of space missions.
What is one of the main challenges of space exploration mentioned in the passage?
A. Lack of interested scientists.
B. Radiation exposure and enormous costs.
C. No satellites have been launched.
D. The ISS has been abandoned.
past_exams.analysis: 文章最后指出太空探索面临的挑战包括"radiation exposure and the enormous cost of space missions"（辐射暴露和巨大成本）。
past_exams.answer: B。文章提到辐射暴露和巨大成本是太空探索的主要挑战。

past_exams.question: There is a meeting ______ (attend) tomorrow.（用不定式填空）
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查不定式作定语。不定式作定语放在名词后，常表将来。meeting与attend是主动关系，用to attend。
past_exams.answer: to attend。不定式作定语表将来，放在名词后。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：Why should we explore space?
___1___ Space exploration leads to technological advances that benefit everyday life, such as GPS and water purification.
___2___ Understanding other planets helps us better understand and protect Earth.
___3___ Exploring space inspires the next generation of scientists and engineers.
A. Technology benefits.  B. Understanding Earth.  C. Inspiring future generations.  D. Wasting resources.  E. Avoiding science.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"太空探索带来技术进步"，对应A。第二段讲"了解其他行星帮助了解地球"，对应B。第三段讲"激励下一代"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调技术进步、了解地球和激励后代。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：The search for extraterrestrial life has been a driving force behind many space missions. Scientists look for 'biosignatures' — signs of life — on planets within the 'habitable zone' of stars, where conditions might allow liquid water to exist. While no definitive evidence of alien life has been found, the discovery of organic molecules on Mars and water vapor on some moons has raised hopes. The search continues, driven by the fundamental question: are we alone in the universe?
What has raised scientists' hopes of finding extraterrestrial life?
A. The discovery of alien civilizations.
B. The finding of organic molecules on Mars and water vapor on some moons.
C. The fact that all planets have liquid water.
D. The complete failure of all space missions.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出"the discovery of organic molecules on Mars and water vapor on some moons has raised hopes"，火星上的有机分子和某些卫星上的水蒸气提高了科学家找到外星生命的希望。
past_exams.answer: B。火星上的有机分子和某些卫星上的水蒸气提高了希望。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"太空探索的意义"的议论文。请你写一篇文章，讨论太空探索的价值。
范文：
The Significance of Space Exploration
Space exploration has always fascinated humanity. In my opinion, it is vital for us to continue exploring the universe.
First, space exploration leads to technological advances. Many technologies we use today, such as GPS and water purification systems, were originally developed for space missions. These innovations benefit our daily lives.
Second, exploring space helps us understand Earth better. By studying other planets, scientists can gain insights into climate change and environmental protection.
However, some argue that space exploration is a waste of money. They believe we should focus on solving problems on Earth first. While this is a valid concern, I believe that the benefits of space exploration far outweigh the costs.
In conclusion, space exploration is not just about curiosity; it is about securing the future of humanity. There is no doubt that it is worthwhile to invest in this endeavor.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查太空探索议论文。①结构清晰（引言→正面论证→反面观点→个人立场→总结）；②不定式用法多样（it is vital to..., it is worthwhile to...）；③论证充分，观点辩证。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：结构完整、论证充分、句式多样、观点明确。

chapters.title: Unit 5 The Value of Money 金钱的价值
chapters.summary: 话题：金钱的价值（以《百万英镑》为例）。语法：复习情态动词与不定式。写作：金钱观讨论/剧本片段。

knowledge.title: 重点词汇
knowledge.content: value 价值/重视（valuable adj. 有价值的；invaluable adj. 无价的；valueless adj. 无价值的）；basis 基础（basic adj. 基本的；base n. 基础 v. 以……为基础）；apologise 道歉（apologise to sb. for sth. 因某事向某人道歉；apology n. 道歉）；spot 发现/认出（spot sb. in the crowd 在人群中认出某人）；patience 耐心（patient adj. 有耐心的 n. 病人；impatiently adv. 不耐烦地）；manner 方式/礼貌（manner方式，manners 礼貌、礼仪）；permission 允许（permit v. 允许）；indeed 确实（= truly/really）；hesitate 犹豫（hesitation n. 犹豫）；reserve 预订/保留（reservation n. 预订）。词汇辨析：value指价值或重视；worth指值多少钱。manner单数指方式/态度，复数manners指礼貌/礼仪。apologise指正式道歉；say sorry指口语道歉。

knowledge.title: 重点短语
knowledge.content: as a matter of fact 事实上（= in fact）；on the basis of 在……基础上；take out a loan 贷款；in return 作为回报（in return for 作为对……的回报）；be about to do 即将做（be about to do...when... 即将做……这时……）；to be honest 老实说（= honestly speaking）。易错提示：be about to do后不接具体时间状语（不能说be about to do tomorrow），常与when连用表示"正要做……这时……"。on the basis of后接名词或动名词。in return单独使用表示"作为回报"，in return for后接具体事物。

knowledge.title: 核心句型
knowledge.content: ①be about to do... when... 即将做某事这时……。例：I was about to leave when the phone rang. 我正要离开这时电话响了。②It is up to sb. to do sth. 做某事取决于某人。例：It is up to you to decide. 由你决定。③情态动词 + have done（表对过去的推测或责备）。例：You should have told me earlier. 你本该早点告诉我。He must have forgotten it. 他一定忘了。

knowledge.title: 语法：复习情态动词与不定式
knowledge.content: 情态动词+have done的用法（高频考点）：①should have done = 本该做但没做（责备/遗憾）。例：You should have finished it yesterday. 你本该昨天完成的。②ought to have done = 本该做但没做（同should have done，语气更正式）。③could have done = 本可以做但没做（遗憾/可能性）。例：You could have passed the exam. 你本可以通过考试的。④needn't have done = 本不必做但做了（后悔/多余）。例：You needn't have bought so much food. 你本不必买这么多食物的。⑤must have done = 一定做过（肯定推测）。例：He must have been here. 他一定来过。⑥can't have done = 不可能做过（否定推测）。例：He can't have done it. 他不可能做过这事。不定式综合运用：①to do表目的、将来。②to have done表先于主句动作完成。③被动形式to be done / to have been done。④不定式作各成分（主语、宾语、表语、定语、状语、补语）。学习提示：情态动词+have done是高考必考结构，关键在于区分should/could/needn't/must/can't have done的不同含义。

exam_points.title: 情态动词+have done
exam_points.content: 情态动词+have done是高考高频考点。解题技巧：①should have done = 本该做但没做（责备/遗憾），否定shouldn't have done = 本不该做但做了。②could have done = 本可以做但没做（遗憾），也可表对过去的可能推测。③needn't have done = 本不必做但做了（多余/后悔）。④must have done = 一定做过（肯定推测），只用于肯定句。⑤can't have done = 不可能做过（否定推测）。⑥would have done = 本会做但没做（虚拟语气）。区分要点：should have done侧重"责备"（本该做没做），could have done侧重"遗憾/能力"（本可以做没做），needn't have done侧重"多余"（做了但没必要）。

exam_points.title: 词汇
exam_points.content: 高频考点：①value/valuable/invaluable/valueless：value n. 价值 v. 重视；valuable adj. 有价值的；invaluable adj. 无价的（极有价值的，注意不是"无价值"）；valueless adj. 无价值的（= worthless）。②manner(s)单复数含义：manner（单数）= 方式/态度（in a friendly manner 以友好的方式）；manners（复数）= 礼貌/礼仪（table manners 餐桌礼仪；good manners 有礼貌）。③permission/permit：permission n. 允许（ask for permission 请求许可）；permit v. 允许（permit sb. to do sth. 允许某人做某事）。解题技巧：invaluable是"无价的"（极有价值），不是"无价值的"；valueless才是"无价值的"。这是高频易错点。

exam_points.title: 写作
exam_points.content: 金钱观讨论和剧本片段是高考写作题型。金钱观议论文要点：①结构：引出话题→分析金钱的作用（正面）→分析金钱的局限（反面）→表明观点→总结。②常用表达：money is not everything 金钱不是万能的；the root of all evil 万恶之源；bring happiness 带来幸福；cannot buy health/friendship/love 买不到健康/友谊/爱情；value relationships 重视人际关系；pursue true happiness 追求真正的幸福。③常用句式：There is no denying that...；It is true that..., but...；What matters most is...。剧本片段要点：①格式：人物名+冒号+台词，舞台指示用括号。②语言：口语化、生动，符合人物身份。③常用表达：stage direction 舞台指示；dialogue 对白；scene 场景。学习提示：金钱观议论要辩证，既承认金钱的必要性，又强调精神追求的重要性。

examples.title: needn't have done（基础题）
examples.question: 填空：You ______ ______ (not/hurry); we still have plenty of time.
examples.analysis: 本题考查needn't have done的用法。分析语境："我们还有很多时间"，说明"你本不必着急"，即已经做了（着急了）但没必要做。needn't have done表示"本不必做但实际做了"，带有后悔或多余的意味。因此填needn't have hurried。解题技巧：needn't have done = 本不必做但做了（强调动作已发生但没必要）；didn't need to do = 不必做（动作不一定发生）。区别：needn't have hurried暗示已经着急了（但没必要）；didn't need to hurry暗示没有着急（因为知道不必）。
examples.answer: needn't have hurried。本不必做用needn't have done。

examples.title: be about to do句型（中档题）
examples.question: 翻译：我刚要出门，这时电话响了。
examples.analysis: 本题考查be about to do...when...句型。分析步骤：①"刚要出门"表即将做某事，用be about to do结构，"出门"用go out。②"这时"用when（when在此表示"这时突然"，不是"当……时"）。③"电话响了"用the phone rang，用一般过去时。④"刚要出门"与"电话响"同时发生，用过去进行时was about to。完整句子：I was about to go out when the phone rang. 解题技巧：be about to do...when...是固定句型，意为"正要做某事这时突然……"。when在此是并列连词，相当于and then。
examples.answer: I was about to go out when the phone rang.

examples.title: 情态动词+have done辨析（高考模拟题）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：— I stayed up late preparing for the exam. — You ______ stayed up so late; the exam has been postponed. A. shouldn't have B. needn't have C. couldn't have D. wouldn't have
examples.analysis: 本题考查情态动词+have done的辨析。分析语境：说话人说"我熬夜准备考试了"，对方说"你本不必熬夜；考试已经推迟了"，表示已经熬夜了但没必要（因为考试推迟了）。四个选项：shouldn't have stayed up = 本不该熬夜但熬了（责备，强调不该做）；needn't have stayed up = 本不必熬夜但熬了（多余，强调没必要）；couldn't have = 不可能（推测，不合语境）；wouldn't have = 本不会（虚拟，不合语境）。语境强调"没必要"而非"不该"，用needn't have。因此选B。解题技巧：needn't have done强调"没必要但做了"（多余）；shouldn't have done强调"不该做但做了"（责备/错误）。
examples.answer: B. needn't have。needn't have done表示本不必做但做了，强调多余。

examples.title: 词汇辨析（高考真题改编）
examples.question: 选择最佳答案：The painting turned out to be ______, so it was sold at a very low price. A. valuable B. invaluable C. valueless D. priceless
examples.analysis: 本题考查value相关形容词的辨析。分析语境："这幅画结果证明是______，所以以很低的价格卖出了"，说明画没有价值。四个选项：valuable = 有价值的；invaluable = 无价的（极有价值的，注意不是"无价值"）；valueless = 无价值的（= worthless）；priceless = 无价的（极有价值的）。根据语境"以很低价格卖出"，说明画无价值，用valueless。因此选C。解题技巧：invaluable和priceless都是"无价的"（极有价值），而非"无价值的"；valueless和worthless才是"无价值的"。invaluable和valueless是形近词但意思相反，是高考高频易错点。
examples.answer: C. valueless。valueless意为"无价值的"，符合低价出售的语境。

past_exams.question: You ______ ______ (not/hurry); we still have plenty of time.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查needn't have done。"我们还有很多时间"说明"你本不必着急"，即已经做了（着急了）但没必要做。needn't have done表示本不必做但做了。
past_exams.answer: needn't have hurried。本不必做用needn't have done，表示做了但没必要。

past_exams.question: I was about to go out ______ the phone rang.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查be about to do...when...句型。"正要做某事这时突然……"，when在此是并列连词，相当于and then。
past_exams.answer: when。be about to do...when...正要做……这时……，when表"这时突然"。

past_exams.question:
The painting turned out to be ______, so it was sold at a very low price.
A. valuable  B. invaluable  C. valueless  D. priceless
past_exams.analysis: "以很低价格卖出"说明画无价值。valuable=有价值的，invaluable=无价的（极有价值），valueless=无价值的，priceless=无价的。用valueless。
past_exams.answer: C. valueless。valueless意为"无价值的"，符合低价出售的语境。

past_exams.question:
— I stayed up late preparing for the exam. — You ______ stayed up so late; the exam has been postponed.
A. shouldn't have  B. needn't have  C. couldn't have  D. wouldn't have
past_exams.analysis: "考试已推迟"说明"你本不必熬夜"，已经熬夜了但没必要。needn't have done表示本不必做但做了（多余）。shouldn't have done是"本不该做"（责备）。
past_exams.answer: B. needn't have。needn't have done表示本不必做但做了，强调多余。

past_exams.question:
完形填空（节选）：In the story 'The Million Pound Bank Note,' Henry Adams was a poor man who found himself in a difficult ______. When he was given a million pound note, his life changed dramatically. The way people treated him showed the ______ of money in society. However, Henry remained honest and did not let money change his ______.
A. situation; value; character  B. situation; price; character  C. position; value; habit  D. situation; value; appearance
past_exams.analysis: 第一空"困难处境"用situation。第二空"金钱的价值"用value。第三空"不让金钱改变他的品格"用character。
past_exams.answer: A. situation; value; character。situation处境；value价值；character品格。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Mark Twain's 'The Million Pound Bank Note' tells the story of Henry Adams, an American who finds himself stranded in London with no money. Two wealthy brothers give him a million pound bank note as part of a bet. The story satirizes society's obsession with wealth, showing how people's attitudes change entirely based on perceived financial status, regardless of the person's actual character.
What is the main theme of 'The Million Pound Bank Note'?
A. How to become rich quickly.
B. The satirical examination of society's obsession with wealth.
C. The importance of saving money.
D. The history of banking in London.
past_exams.analysis: 文章指出该故事"satirizes society's obsession with wealth"（讽刺社会对财富的痴迷），展示了人们的态度如何完全基于表面的财务状况而改变。
past_exams.answer: B。故事的主题是讽刺社会对财富的痴迷。

past_exams.question:
You ______ have told me earlier! Now I've already bought a ticket.
A. should  B. could  C. must  D. might
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查should have done表责备/遗憾。"你本该早点告诉我！我已经买了票了。"表示本该做但没做，带有责备语气。
past_exams.answer: A. should。should have done表示"本该做但没做"，表责备。

past_exams.question:
七选五（节选）：What is the true value of money?
___1___ Money is necessary for meeting basic needs such as food, shelter, and education.
___2___ However, money cannot buy genuine friendships, love, or good health.
___3___ True happiness comes from meaningful relationships and personal fulfillment, not wealth.
A. Meeting basic needs.  B. Money's limitations.  C. True happiness.  D. Earning more money.  E. Ignoring relationships.
past_exams.analysis: 第一段讲"金钱满足基本需求"，对应A。第二段讲"金钱买不到的东西"，对应B。第三段讲"真正的幸福来源"，对应C。
past_exams.answer: 1-A, 2-B, 3-C。各段分别强调基本需求、金钱局限和真正幸福。

past_exams.question:
阅读理解（节选）：Studies on happiness and wealth have produced surprising results. While money can increase happiness up to a certain income level — enough to cover basic needs and provide some comfort — beyond that point, the correlation between wealth and happiness weakens significantly. Researcher Daniel Kahneman found that emotional well-being plateaus at an annual income of about $75,000. Beyond this, additional income does not lead to proportional increases in daily happiness.
What does the research suggest about money and happiness?
A. More money always leads to more happiness.
B. Money increases happiness up to a point, after which the effect diminishes.
C. Money has no effect on happiness at all.
D. Poor people are always happier than rich people.
past_exams.analysis: 研究表明金钱在满足基本需求和一定舒适度之前能增加幸福感，但超过某一点后（约$75,000），财富与幸福的关联性显著减弱。
past_exams.answer: B。金钱在一定范围内增加幸福感，超过该点后效果递减。

past_exams.question:
应用文写作：假定你是李华，你校英语报社正在征集关于"金钱能否买到幸福"的讨论文章。请你写一篇议论文，表达你的观点。
范文：
Can Money Buy Happiness?
There has been a long debate about whether money can buy happiness. In my opinion, the answer is both yes and no.
On one hand, money is essential for meeting our basic needs. It is true that without enough money, people may suffer from hunger and poverty, which certainly leads to unhappiness. Money also provides access to education and healthcare, which contribute to well-being.
On the other hand, money cannot buy everything that matters. You should have realized by now that genuine friendships, family love, and good health are far more valuable than any amount of money. Many wealthy people are still unhappy because they lack meaningful relationships.
In conclusion, money is a tool, not an end. It is up to us to use money wisely rather than being controlled by it. True happiness comes from within, not from our bank accounts.
past_exams.analysis: 本题考查金钱观议论文。①结构清晰（引言→正面→反面→总结）；②使用情态动词+have done（should have realized）；③使用倒装（It is up to us to...）；④观点辩证，论证充分。
past_exams.answer: 范文如题所示。评分要点：结构完整、论证充分、句式多样、观点辩证。
